n9.speaker: ryan
n9.text: Cheers! See you later! Tell Mum I had breakfast!

translations.fa: ممنون! بعداً می‌بینمت! به مامان بگو صبحونه خوردم!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: It's so hot today! Let's sit down and have a cold drink.

translations.fa: امروز خیلی گرمه! بیا بشینیم و یه نوشیدنی خنک بخوریم.

branches.suggestion: Good idea. I'm really thirsty.
Yes. It's very hot!

n2.speaker: callum
n2.text: Hiya! What can I get you?

translations.fa: سلام! چی براتون بیارم؟

branches.suggestion: Could I have a glass of water, please?
branches.suggestionFa: می‌شه یه لیوان آب داشته باشم، لطفاً؟

branches.suggestion: Can I have an orange juice, please?
branches.suggestionFa: می‌شه یه آب پرتقال بدید، لطفاً؟

recasts.echo: A glass of water? Sure!
recasts.better: Could I have a glass of water, please?

n3.speaker: callum
n3.text: Sure. Tap water is free. Or still or sparkling bottled water?

translations.fa: حتماً. آب لوله‌کشی رایگانه. یا آب معدنی معمولی یا گازدار؟

branches.suggestion: Tap water is fine, thanks.
Sparkling, please.

cultureNote.en: In the UK, places that sell alcohol must give free tap water if you ask. British tap water is safe to drink.
cultureNote.fa: آب لوله‌کشی رایگان و سالم است.

n4.speaker: callum
n4.text: With ice and lemon?

translations.fa: با یخ و لیمو؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, please. Lots of ice!
Just ice, please. No lemon.

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: And I'll have an iced latte, please. Callum, is it always this busy?

translations.fa: و من یه لاته سرد می‌خوام، لطفاً. کالوم، همیشه این‌قدر شلوغه؟

branches.suggestion: It's very busy today!
Everyone wants a cold drink!

n6.speaker: callum
n6.text: It's the sunshine! Twenty-five degrees. That's a heatwave for London!

translations.fa: به‌خاطر آفتابه! بیست و پنج درجه. برای لندن این موج گرماست!

branches.suggestion: Twenty-five is not hot in Iran!
branches.suggestionFa: بیست و پنج تو ایران گرم نیست!

branches.suggestion: Ha ha! That's normal for me.

cultureNote.en: Britain uses Celsius for weather, but older people sometimes talk in Fahrenheit for hot days.
cultureNote.fa: سلسیوس رایج است.

n7.speaker: callum
n7.text: Lucky you! Here you are: water with ice, and an iced latte. That's three pounds twenty.

translations.fa: خوش به حالت! بفرما: آب با یخ، و یه لاته سرد. سه پوند و بیست میشه.

branches.suggestion: Can I pay by card?
Let me pay, Leslie.

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: No, no, my treat! You can buy next time. Thanks, Callum!

translations.fa: نه نه، مهمون من! دفعهٔ بعد تو بخر. ممنون کالوم!

branches.suggestion: Thank you, Leslie. That's kind.
OK, next time is my turn!

n9.speaker: leslie
n9.text: Ahh, that's better. Nothing beats a cold drink on a hot day. Cheers!

translations.fa: آه، بهتر شد. هیچی مثل یه نوشیدنی خنک تو یه روز گرم نیست. به سلامتی!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Lunchtime! I'm making sandwiches. What would you like in yours?

translations.fa: وقت ناهار! دارم ساندویچ درست می‌کنم. تو مال خودت چی می‌خوای؟

branches.suggestion: Cheese, please.
What have we got?

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Cheese, ham, tuna, egg… and cucumber. White bread or brown bread?

translations.fa: پنیر، ژامبون، تن ماهی، تخم‌مرغ… و خیار. نون سفید یا نون سبوس‌دار؟

branches.suggestion: Brown bread, please.
White, please.

cultureNote.en: Many British Muslims, Jews and vegetarians avoid ham — it's always fine to ask what's in a sandwich.
cultureNote.fa: می‌توانید محتویات ساندویچ را بپرسید.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Brown bread. Do you want butter on it?

translations.fa: نون سبوس‌دار. کره می‌خوای روش؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, a little butter, please.
No butter, thanks.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Cheese and pickle? It's a classic! Pickle is sweet and brown.

translations.fa: پنیر و پیکل؟ کلاسیکه! پیکل شیرین و قهوه‌ایه.

branches.suggestion: I'd like to try it.
Just cheese and tomato, please.

cultureNote.en: "Branston Pickle" is a sweet, chunky brown chutney — cheese and pickle is a classic British sandwich.
cultureNote.fa: پنیر و ترشی ساندویچ کلاسیک است.

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: There you go. Ryan wants crisps in his sandwich! What do you think?

translations.fa: بفرما. رایان می‌خواد تو ساندویچش چیپس بذاره! نظرت چیه؟

branches.suggestion: Crisps in a sandwich? Really?
That sounds crunchy!

cultureNote.en: A "crisp sandwich" or "crisp butty" is a real (and loved) British snack.
cultureNote.fa: ساندویچ چیپس واقعاً وجود دارد!

recasts.echo: Crisps in a sandwich? Yes, really!

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: It's a "crisp butty". Very popular here! Shall I cut yours into triangles or squares?

translations.fa: بهش می‌گن «کریسپ باتی». اینجا خیلی محبوبه! مال تو را مثلثی ببرم یا مربعی؟

branches.suggestion: Triangles, please.
Don't cut it, thanks.

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Triangles. Fancy. Would you like a drink with it?

translations.fa: مثلثی. شیک. باهاش نوشیدنی می‌خوای؟

branches.suggestion: A glass of water, please.
Have we got any juice?

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: There's apple juice in the fridge. Help yourself!

translations.fa: آب سیب تو یخچاله. از خودت پذیرایی کن!

branches.suggestion: Thanks! Shall I get some for you?
Thank you. This looks delicious!
branches.suggestionFa: ممنون. خیلی خوشمزه به نظر میاد!

n9.speaker: leslie
n9.text: Yes, please, a small one. Right, let's eat in the garden. It's sunny!

translations.fa: آره، لطفاً، یه کم. خب، بیا تو باغ بخوریم. آفتابیه!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Nicola's got a school trip tomorrow. She needs a packed lunch. Can you help me?

translations.fa: نیکولا فردا اردوی مدرسه داره. ناهار بسته‌بندی لازم داره. کمکم می‌کنی؟

branches.suggestion: Yes. What does she need?
Sure. Where's her lunch box?

cultureNote.en: For school trips, British children often take a "packed lunch" with no nuts, because of allergies.
cultureNote.fa: ناهار بدون آجیل به‌خاطر آلرژی.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Her lunch box is the purple one. First, a sandwich. Have we got any bread?

translations.fa: ظرف ناهارش بنفشه‌ست. اول یه ساندویچ. نون داریم؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, there's some bread.
No, there isn't any bread.

recasts.echo: There isn't any bread? Oh dear!

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Good, there's half a loaf. Now, a snack. No nuts — the school says no nuts.

translations.fa: خوبه، نصف یه نون هست. حالا، یه خوراکی. بدون آجیل — مدرسه می‌گه آجیل نه.

branches.suggestion: What about a yoghurt?
She can have an apple.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: A yoghurt in a tube! Great. Have we got any crisps?

translations.fa: یه ماست تیوبی! عالی. چیپس داریم؟

branches.suggestion: There are some in the cupboard.
I think Ryan ate them all!
branches.suggestionFa: فکر کنم رایان همه را خورد!

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Ryan! Always Ryan! OK, no crisps. What else can she have?

translations.fa: رایان! همیشه رایان! باشه، چیپس نه. دیگه چی می‌تونه داشته باشه؟

branches.suggestion: Some carrot sticks?
A small cake?

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Carrot sticks and a little cake. A treat for the trip! And a drink.

translations.fa: هویج قلمی و یه کیک کوچیک. یه جایزه برای اردو! و یه نوشیدنی.

branches.suggestion: Water is best for a trip.
Has she got a water bottle?

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Yes, her unicorn bottle. Now, write her name on everything! Things always get lost.

translations.fa: آره، بطری اسب‌شاخدارش. حالا، اسمش را رو همه چی بنویس! همیشه چیزها گم می‌شن.

branches.suggestion: Where's the pen?
N-I-C-O-L-A. Done!

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Perfect. Put it in the fridge. Thank you, love. Now I just need to remember it tomorrow morning!

translations.fa: عالی. بذارش تو یخچال. ممنون عزیزم. حالا فقط باید فردا صبح یادم بمونه!

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: I'm starving! It's one o'clock. What shall we have for lunch?

translations.fa: دارم از گرسنگی می‌میرم! ساعت یکه. ناهار چی بخوریم؟

branches.suggestion: I'm hungry too. What's in the fridge?
branches.suggestionFa: منم گرسنه‌ام. تو یخچال چی هست؟

branches.suggestion: Let's have something quick.

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: Something quick… Beans on toast! The best British lunch. Have you tried it?

translations.fa: یه چیز سریع… لوبیا روی نون تست! بهترین ناهار بریتانیایی. امتحانش کردی؟

branches.suggestion: No, never.
Yes, I love it!

cultureNote.en: Baked beans in tomato sauce on toast is a cheap, quick, classic British meal.
cultureNote.fa: لوبیا روی نان تست غذای ساده و کلاسیک است.

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: You'll love it. Can you open the tin? The tin opener is in the drawer.

translations.fa: عاشقش می‌شی. قوطی را باز می‌کنی؟ دربازکن تو کشوئه.

branches.suggestion: This one?
It's a ring pull. No opener!

cultureNote.en: British "tin", American "can".
cultureNote.fa: tin/can.

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: Pour the beans in the pan. I'll put the bread in the toaster. Two slices each?

translations.fa: لوبیا را بریز تو تابه. من نون را می‌ذارم تو توستر. هر نفر دو تیکه؟

branches.suggestion: Two slices, please.
One is enough for me.

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: Stir the beans, please. Don't let them burn!

translations.fa: لوبیا را هم بزن، لطفاً. نذار بسوزه!

branches.suggestion: I'm stirring. They're bubbling!
branches.suggestionFa: دارم هم می‌زنم. داره قل می‌زنه!

branches.suggestion: Is it hot enough?

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: Toast's ready! Butter on the toast, then beans on top. Do you want cheese on yours?

translations.fa: تست آماده‌ست! کره رو تست، بعد لوبیا رو بالاش. رو مال تو پنیر بریزم؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, please! Lots of cheese.
No, thanks. Just beans.

recasts.echo: With cheese? Good choice!

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: Cheese on top. Now, the secret: a bit of brown sauce. Try it!

translations.fa: پنیر رو بالاش. حالا، راز کار: یه کم سس قهوه‌ای. امتحانش کن!

branches.suggestion: Mmm! It's delicious!
It's a bit strange, but good!

cultureNote.en: Brits argue about "red sauce" (ketchup) or "brown sauce" (HP) — it's a fun debate.
cultureNote.fa: سس قرمز یا قهوه‌ای؛ بحث همیشگی.

n8.speaker: tom
n8.text: See? Five minutes and only one pan to wash. That's my kind of cooking!

translations.fa: دیدی؟ پنج دقیقه و فقط یه تابه برای شستن. این آشپزی مورد علاقهٔ منه!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: Lunch is finished! Mummy says we must clear the table. Can you help me?

translations.fa: ناهار تموم شد! مامان می‌گه باید میز را جمع کنیم. کمکم می‌کنی؟

branches.suggestion: Of course. Let's do it together.
branches.suggestionFa: البته. بیا با هم انجامش بدیم.

branches.suggestion: Yes. What do I do first?

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: First, the plates. Put them next to the sink.

translations.fa: اول، بشقاب‌ها. بذارشون کنار سینک.

branches.suggestion: All the plates?
OK. Careful, they're heavy!

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: I'll do the cups. They're not heavy. Where do the leftovers go?

translations.fa: من لیوان‌ها را می‌برم. سنگین نیستن. پس‌مونده‌ها کجا می‌رن؟

branches.suggestion: In the food bin.
In the brown bin, I think.

cultureNote.en: Many British councils collect food waste separately in a small "food caddy" or brown bin.
cultureNote.fa: زبالهٔ غذایی جدا جمع می‌شود.

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: Yes! The little brown caddy. And the crisp packets go in the black bin.

translations.fa: آره! سطل کوچولوی قهوه‌ای. و پاکت‌های چیپس می‌رن تو سطل مشکی.

branches.suggestion: And the juice bottle?
Is the bottle for recycling?

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: Bottles go in the recycling. The green box. Now, wipe the table, please.

translations.fa: بطری‌ها می‌رن تو بازیافت. جعبهٔ سبز. حالا، میز را دستمال بکش، لطفاً.

branches.suggestion: Where's the cloth?
I'm wiping it now.

recasts.echo: Where's the cloth? By the tap.

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: By the tap. Oh, there's a crumb on the floor. And another one!

translations.fa: کنار شیر آب. آه، یه خرده نون رو زمینه. و یکی دیگه!

branches.suggestion: Let's sweep the floor.
Where's the dustpan and brush?

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Under the sink. I can sweep! Look, I'm very good at sweeping.

translations.fa: زیر سینک. من می‌تونم جارو کنم! ببین، من خیلی تو جارو کردن خوبم.

branches.suggestion: You're brilliant at it!
Wow! Well done, Nicola!

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Finished! The kitchen is clean! Mummy, look! Can we have a sweet now? We were very helpful!

translations.fa: تموم شد! آشپزخونه تمیزه! مامان، ببین! حالا می‌تونیم یه شکلات بخوریم؟ خیلی کمک کردیم!

n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: Come in! Welcome to my room. Sorry, it's a bit messy. Do you like my posters?

translations.fa: بیا تو! به اتاقم خوش اومدی. ببخشید، یه کم به‌هم‌ریخته‌ست. پوسترهام را دوست داری؟

branches.suggestion: Yes! Who's that?
They're cool!

n2.speaker: ryan
n2.text: That's Bukayo Saka. He's a footballer. He plays for Arsenal. Do you like football?

translations.fa: اون بوکایو ساکاست. فوتبالیسته. برای آرسنال بازی می‌کنه. فوتبال دوست داری؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I love football.
Not really. I like basketball.

cultureNote.en: British "football" is American "soccer". American "football" is a different sport.
cultureNote.fa: football/soccer.

n3.speaker: ryan
n3.text: Basketball's cool too. That one's my favourite band. They're from Manchester.

translations.fa: بسکتبال هم باحاله. اون یکی گروه مورد علاقه‌مه. اهل منچسترن.

branches.suggestion: What kind of music is it?
I don't know them. Are they good?

n4.speaker: ryan
n4.text: Indie rock. They're brilliant. I saw them live last summer!

translations.fa: ایندی راک. فوق‌العاده‌ان. تابستون پارسال اجرای زنده‌شون را دیدم!

branches.suggestion: Lucky you!
Was it a big concert?

n5.speaker: ryan
n5.text: Massive! Who's your favourite singer?

translations.fa: خیلی بزرگ! خوانندهٔ مورد علاقه‌ات کیه؟

branches.suggestion: I like Adele.
My favourite singer is Persian. You don't know him.

cultureNote.en: Adele is from Tottenham, in north London, not far from Hackney.
cultureNote.fa: ادل اهل تاتنهام لندن است.

recasts.echo: Adele is your favourite? Good choice!

n6.speaker: ryan
n6.text: Play me a song later! What's that on my desk? Oh, my old games console.

translations.fa: بعداً یه آهنگ برام بذار! اون رو میزم چیه؟ آه، کنسول بازی قدیمیم.

branches.suggestion: Does it still work?
Can we play a game?

n7.speaker: ryan
n7.text: It works, but it's ancient. Look at my bed — it's under all my clothes!

translations.fa: کار می‌کنه، ولی خیلی قدیمیه. تختم را ببین — زیر همهٔ لباس‌هامه!

branches.suggestion: Where's the bed? I can't see it!
Your mum won't be happy!

n8.speaker: ryan
n8.text: Ha! She says my room is a "pigsty". That means a home for pigs. Is your room tidy?

translations.fa: ها! می‌گه اتاقم «خوکدونیه». یعنی خونهٔ خوک‌ها. اتاق تو مرتبه؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, my room is very tidy.
Not always!

n9.speaker: ryan
n9.text: Good. Then you can tidy mine! Just joking. Come on, let's go and get some crisps.

translations.fa: خوبه. پس می‌تونی مال منو مرتب کنی! شوخی کردم. بیا، بریم یه کم چیپس بگیریم.

n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: I can't find my football socks! The match starts in twenty minutes!

translations.fa: جوراب‌های فوتبالم را پیدا نمی‌کنم! بازی بیست دقیقهٔ دیگه شروع میشه!

branches.suggestion: What colour are they?
Don't panic. I'll help you.

n2.speaker: ryan
n2.text: Red and white. Are they under the bed?

translations.fa: قرمز و سفید. زیر تختن؟

branches.suggestion: No, they aren't under the bed.
There's a sock here, but it's blue.

match: no they isn't under the bed
recasts.echo: Not under the bed? Hmm.

n3.speaker: ryan
n3.text: Blue? That's not mine. Are they in the drawer?

translations.fa: آبی؟ مال من نیست. تو کشوئن؟

branches.suggestion: No, the drawer is full of T-shirts.
I can see pants, but no socks!

cultureNote.en: British "pants" = underwear; American "pants" = British "trousers"!
cultureNote.fa: pants در بریتانیا یعنی شورت.

n4.speaker: ryan
n4.text: Ha! Pants. What about the washing basket?

translations.fa: ها! شورت. سبد لباس‌چرک چطور؟

branches.suggestion: Yes! Here they are, in the washing basket.
They're in the basket… but they're dirty!

n5.speaker: ryan
n5.text: Dirty? Oh no! Are they very smelly?

translations.fa: کثیف؟ وای نه! خیلی بو می‌دن؟

branches.suggestion: Yes. Very smelly!
Not too bad.

n6.speaker: ryan
n6.text: I've got no time to wash them. I'll wear them! Where's my other boot?

translations.fa: وقت ندارم بشورمشون. همینا را می‌پوشم! اون یکی کفش فوتبالم کجاست؟

branches.suggestion: Is it behind the door?
On the shelf, next to the trophy.

n7.speaker: ryan
n7.text: Next to the trophy! Brilliant. My water bottle? Have you seen it?

translations.fa: کنار جام! عالی. بطری آبم؟ دیدیش؟

branches.suggestion: It's on your desk.
I think it's in the kitchen.

n8.speaker: ryan
n8.text: Desk, yes. Socks, boots, water, shin pads… I'm ready! Thanks, mate!

translations.fa: میز، آره. جوراب، کفش، آب، ساق‌بند… آماده‌ام! ممنون رفیق!

branches.suggestion: Good luck! Score a goal!
Have a good match!

cultureNote.en: "Mate" is a friendly British word for a friend — like "dude" in American English.
cultureNote.fa: mate یعنی رفیق.

n9.speaker: ryan
n9.text: Cheers! Come and watch if you want. It's at the park. Bring Nicola — she shouts the loudest!

translations.fa: ممنون! اگه خواستی بیا تماشا. تو پارکه. نیکولا را هم بیار — از همه بلندتر داد می‌زنه!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: It's sheet-changing day! Can you help me with Ryan's bed? He's at football.

translations.fa: امروز روز عوض کردن ملافه‌ست! تو تخت رایان کمکم می‌کنی؟ رفته فوتبال.

branches.suggestion: Sure. What do I do?
Of course. It's very messy!

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: First, take the pillowcases off. Put them in the basket.

translations.fa: اول، روبالشی‌ها را دربیار. بذارشون تو سبد.

branches.suggestion: OK. Two pillowcases.
Done. What next?

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Now the duvet cover. This is the hard bit!

translations.fa: حالا روکش لحاف. این قسمت سخته!

branches.suggestion: Wow, it's very big!
Let's do it together.

cultureNote.en: Brits say "duvet"; Americans often say "comforter". Putting the cover on is a famous struggle!
cultureNote.fa: duvet/comforter.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Take the sheet off the mattress too. Oh! What's that under the mattress?

translations.fa: ملافه را هم از روی تشک بردار. آه! اون زیر تشک چیه؟

branches.suggestion: It's a chocolate bar!
I think it's a comic!

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Chocolate! Ryan! Right, put the clean sheet on. Pull the corners tight.

translations.fa: شکلات! رایان! خب، ملافهٔ تمیز را بنداز. گوشه‌ها را محکم بکش.

branches.suggestion: Like this?
The corners are tight now.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Now the duvet. Put your arms in the cover, hold the corners and shake!

translations.fa: حالا لحاف. دستات را بکن تو روکش، گوشه‌ها را بگیر و تکون بده!

branches.suggestion: Shake, shake, shake!
Help! I'm inside the cover!

recasts.echo: You're inside the cover? Ha ha!

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Ha ha! Everyone does that the first time. Now the pillowcases.

translations.fa: ها ها! همه بار اول این کار را می‌کنن. حالا روبالشی‌ها.

branches.suggestion: This one is blue, that one is grey.
branches.suggestionFa: این یکی آبیه، اون یکی طوسی.

branches.suggestion: Easy! Pillows done.

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Fold the blanket and put it on the end of the bed.

translations.fa: پتو را تا کن و بذارش پایین تخت.

branches.suggestion: Fold it in half?
There we go. All finished!

n9.speaker: leslie
n9.text: Beautiful! Ryan won't know his own bed. Now, let's change ours — just kidding! A cup of tea first.

translations.fa: قشنگه! رایان تخت خودش را نمی‌شناسه. حالا، بریم مال خودمون را عوض کنیم — شوخی کردم! اول یه فنجون چای.

n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: Is it ten o'clock already? Mum says lights out at ten on school nights.

translations.fa: ساعت ده شده؟ مامان می‌گه شب‌های مدرسه ساعت ده چراغ خاموش.

branches.suggestion: Yes, it's ten. Time for bed!
It's five to ten.

n2.speaker: ryan
n2.text: Ten more minutes. I'm in the middle of a game. Please don't tell Mum!

translations.fa: ده دقیقه دیگه. وسط یه بازی‌ام. خواهش می‌کنم به مامان نگو!

branches.suggestion: Five more minutes. That's all.
You've got school tomorrow, Ryan.

n3.speaker: ryan
n3.text: OK, OK. Five minutes. Can you put my alarm on? Seven o'clock.

translations.fa: باشه، باشه. پنج دقیقه. ساعت زنگ‌دارم را تنظیم می‌کنی؟ ساعت هفت.

branches.suggestion: Seven o'clock. Done.
Seven? That's early!

n4.speaker: ryan
n4.text: I need to shower before school. Can you close the curtains, please?

translations.fa: باید قبل از مدرسه دوش بگیرم. پرده‌ها را می‌بندی، لطفاً؟

branches.suggestion: Sure. It's dark outside.
The street light is very bright.

n5.speaker: ryan
n5.text: Thanks. OK, game over. I lost! Where's my phone charger?

translations.fa: ممنون. خب، بازی تموم. باختم! شارژر گوشیم کجاست؟

branches.suggestion: It's next to your bed.
Here it is. Under your pillow!

match: is next to the bed it
recasts.echo: Next to your bed? Got it.

n6.speaker: ryan
n6.text: Under my pillow! Classic. Mum says no phones in bed. Do you think that's fair?

translations.fa: زیر بالشم! همیشه همینه. مامان می‌گه گوشی تو تخت ممنوع. فکر می‌کنی منصفانه‌ست؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, phones are bad for sleep.
Maybe. My mum said the same!

cultureNote.en: Many British parents set "no screens in the bedroom" rules for teenagers to help them sleep.
cultureNote.fa: قانون بدون صفحه نمایش در اتاق.

n7.speaker: ryan
n7.text: Mums are all the same! OK, phone on the desk. Can you turn the big light off?

translations.fa: مامان‌ها همه مثل همن! باشه، گوشی رو میز. چراغ بزرگه را خاموش می‌کنی؟

branches.suggestion: Light off. Good night, Ryan!
Sleep well!

n8.speaker: ryan
n8.text: Night! Thanks, mate. And don't tell Mum about the extra five minutes!

translations.fa: شب بخیر! ممنون رفیق. و دربارهٔ اون پنج دقیقهٔ اضافه به مامان چیزی نگو!

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Morning! Off to work soon. Do you know what I do?

translations.fa: صبح بخیر! به زودی می‌رم سر کار. می‌دونی من چه کاره‌ام؟

branches.suggestion: No. What do you do, Tom?
Are you a driver?

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: I'm a bus driver. I drive the number 38 bus through Hackney every day.

translations.fa: راننده اتوبوسم. هر روز اتوبوس شمارهٔ ۳۸ را تو هاکنی می‌رونم.

branches.suggestion: That sounds busy!
Do you like your job?

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: I love it, most days! Rush hour is crazy. Hundreds of people!

translations.fa: بیشتر روزها عاشقشم! ساعت شلوغی دیوونه‌کننده‌ست. صدها نفر!

branches.suggestion: I can imagine!
Do you work at weekends?

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: Sometimes. I start at six and finish at three. What about you? What do you do?

translations.fa: گاهی. ساعت شش شروع می‌کنم و سه تموم می‌کنم. تو چی؟ چه کاره‌ای؟

branches.suggestion: I'm an engineer.
I'm looking for a job at the moment.

cultureNote.en: In English we say "I'm AN engineer" — with "a" or "an" before jobs.
cultureNote.fa: قبل از شغل a/an می‌آید.

recasts.echo: You're an engineer? Brilliant!

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: Good for you. It's not easy to find a job in a new country. What did you do back home?

translations.fa: آفرین بهت. پیدا کردن کار تو یه کشور جدید آسون نیست. تو کشورت چی کار می‌کردی؟

branches.suggestion: I worked in an office.
I was a teacher.

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: An office worker! You'll find something here, I'm sure. My friend Mr Osei at the Jobcentre is great.

translations.fa: کارمند دفتری! مطمئنم اینجا یه چیزی پیدا می‌کنی. دوستم آقای اوسی تو جاب‌سنتر عالیه.

branches.suggestion: What's the Jobcentre?
Thanks, Tom. That's kind.

cultureNote.en: Jobcentre Plus is the government office that helps people find work.
cultureNote.fa: جاب‌سنتر اداره دولتی کاریابی است.

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: It's a government office. They help people find work. Free!

translations.fa: یه ادارهٔ دولتیه. به مردم کمک می‌کنن کار پیدا کنن. رایگان!

branches.suggestion: Free? That's great.
Can you give me the address?

n8.speaker: tom
n8.text: I'll text it to you. Right, I'm off. Where are my keys? Ah, here! See you at teatime!

translations.fa: برات پیامکش می‌کنم. خب، من رفتم. کلیدام کجان؟ آه، اینجان! سر شام می‌بینمت!

branches.suggestion: Have a good day at work!
branches.suggestionFa: روز خوبی سر کار داشته باشی!

branches.suggestion: Bye, Tom!

n9.speaker: tom
n9.text: Cheers! Don't let Nicola eat all the biscuits!

translations.fa: ممنون! نذار نیکولا همهٔ بیسکویت‌ها را بخوره!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Do you know my job? I'm a teacher at Nicola's school.

translations.fa: شغل منو می‌دونی؟ تو مدرسهٔ نیکولا معلمم.

branches.suggestion: A teacher? What do you teach?
Is Nicola in your class?

cultureNote.en: English primary schools go from Reception (age 4–5) to Year 6 (age 10–11).
cultureNote.fa: مدارس ابتدایی از Reception تا Year 6.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: No, I teach Year Four. They're eight and nine. Nicola's in Reception. I teach everything!

translations.fa: نه، من کلاس چهارم درس می‌دم. هشت و نه ساله‌ان. نیکولا تو پیش‌دبستانیه. همه چی درس می‌دم!

branches.suggestion: That sounds lovely.
Do you like children?

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: I love them! Every day is different. Some days a child cries, some days they make me laugh.

translations.fa: عاشقشونم! هر روز فرق داره. بعضی روزها یه بچه گریه می‌کنه، بعضی روزها منو می‌خندونن.

branches.suggestion: What time do you start?
Is it hard work?

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: I start at half past eight and finish at half past three. Then I collect Nicola.

translations.fa: ساعت هشت و نیم شروع می‌کنم و سه و نیم تموم می‌کنم. بعد نیکولا را برمی‌دارم.

branches.suggestion: That's very handy.
Who looks after William?

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Maggie looks after William. She's wonderful. What does your family do?

translations.fa: مگی از ویلیام مراقبت می‌کنه. فوق‌العاده‌ست. خانوادهٔ تو چی کار می‌کنن؟

branches.suggestion: My father is a doctor.
My mother works in a bank.

match: mother is work in a bank
recasts.echo: Your mother works in a bank? Interesting!
recasts.better: My mother works in a bank.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Interesting! Does she like it?

translations.fa: جالبه! دوستش داره؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, she likes numbers.
She's retired now.

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Lovely. Oh, I must mark these spellings tonight. Twenty-eight little books!

translations.fa: عالی. آه، امشب باید این دیکته‌ها را تصحیح کنم. بیست و هشت تا دفتر کوچولو!

branches.suggestion: Can I help you?
That's a lot of work!

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Ooh, would you? You can put the gold stars on! The children love gold stars.

translations.fa: اوه، واقعاً؟ می‌تونی ستاره‌های طلایی را بچسبونی! بچه‌ها عاشق ستارهٔ طلایی‌ان.

n1.speaker: weda
n1.text: Do you know, I worked here at this library for thirty years!

translations.fa: می‌دونستی، من سی سال همین‌جا تو این کتابخونه کار کردم!

branches.suggestion: Really? Thirty years?
Were you a librarian?

n2.speaker: weda
n2.text: Yes, I was a librarian. I loved it. Books, books, books!

translations.fa: آره، کتابدار بودم. عاشقش بودم. کتاب، کتاب، کتاب!

branches.suggestion: What did you do every day?
Did you read all the books?

n3.speaker: weda
n3.text: Not all! I helped people find books. I read stories to children on Saturdays.

translations.fa: همه نه! به مردم کمک می‌کردم کتاب پیدا کنن. شنبه‌ها برای بچه‌ها قصه می‌خوندم.

branches.suggestion: That sounds wonderful.
Did Leslie come here as a child?
branches.suggestionFa: لزلی بچه که بود میومد اینجا؟

n4.speaker: weda
n4.text: Every Saturday! She sat right there, on that red chair.

translations.fa: هر شنبه! درست اونجا، رو اون صندلی قرمز می‌نشست.

branches.suggestion: On that chair? How sweet!
Is it the same chair?

n5.speaker: bennett
n5.text: Hello, Maggie! Lovely to see you. Is this your friend?

translations.fa: سلام مگی! خوشحالم می‌بینمت. این دوستته؟

branches.suggestion: Hello! Nice to meet you.
Yes. Maggie is showing me the library.
branches.suggestionFa: آره. مگی داره کتابخونه را نشونم می‌ده.

n6.speaker: bennett
n6.text: Maggie was my boss. She was the best boss! Did she tell you about the flood?

translations.fa: مگی رئیس من بود. بهترین رئیس بود! ماجرای سیل را برات تعریف کرد؟

branches.suggestion: No. What happened?
A flood? In the library?

recasts.echo: What happened? Oh, it's a good story!

n7.speaker: weda
n7.text: A pipe burst in 1998. Water everywhere! We carried the books upstairs all night.

translations.fa: سال ۱۹۹۸ یه لوله ترکید. همه جا آب! تمام شب کتاب‌ها را بردیم طبقهٔ بالا.

branches.suggestion: All night? You were very brave.
Did you save the books?

n8.speaker: weda
n8.text: Most of them! Now I just come here to read and use the computers. I'm a customer now!

translations.fa: بیشترشون را! حالا فقط میام اینجا که بخونم و از کامپیوترها استفاده کنم. الان مشتری‌ام!

branches.suggestion: Do you miss working here?
branches.suggestionFa: دلتون برای کار اینجا تنگ شده؟

branches.suggestion: The library is lucky to have you.
branches.suggestionFa: کتابخونه خوش‌شانسه که شما را داره.

n9.speaker: weda
n9.text: Sometimes. But now I've got time for my grandchildren — and for you! Shall we get you a library card?

translations.fa: گاهی. ولی حالا برای نوه‌هام وقت دارم — و برای تو! بریم برات یه کارت کتابخونه بگیریم؟

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: When I grow up, I want to be a vet! Mia wants to be an astronaut!

translations.fa: وقتی بزرگ شدم، می‌خوام دامپزشک بشم! میا می‌خواد فضانورد بشه!

branches.suggestion: A vet? Why?
An astronaut! That's exciting!

cultureNote.en: British "vet" is short for "veterinary surgeon"; Americans also say "veterinarian".
cultureNote.fa: vet مخفف veterinary surgeon.

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: Because I love animals. I want to help poorly dogs and cats.

translations.fa: چون عاشق حیوون‌هام. می‌خوام به سگ و گربه‌های مریض کمک کنم.

branches.suggestion: You'll be a great vet.
What about horses?

n3.speaker: mia
n3.text: I want to go to the moon. And Mars! What did you want to be?

translations.fa: من می‌خوام برم ماه. و مریخ! تو می‌خواستی چی بشی؟

branches.suggestion: I wanted to be a pilot.
I wanted to be a footballer!

recasts.echo: You wanted to be a pilot? Cool!
recasts.better: I wanted to be a pilot.

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: A pilot! Can you fly a plane?

translations.fa: خلبان! می‌تونی هواپیما برونی؟

branches.suggestion: No, I can't!
Only in computer games.

n5.speaker: mia
n5.text: My daddy is a nurse. He works at night at the hospital.

translations.fa: بابای من پرستاره. شب‌ها تو بیمارستان کار می‌کنه.

branches.suggestion: Nurses are very important.
That's hard work.

cultureNote.en: In Britain both men and women are nurses; "nurse" is for everyone.
cultureNote.fa: پرستار برای زن و مرد.

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: Ryan wants to be a… what is it? He fixes computers.

translations.fa: رایان می‌خواد … چی بود؟ کامپیوتر درست می‌کنه.

branches.suggestion: An IT technician?
A computer engineer?

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Yes! And William wants to be a dinosaur!

translations.fa: آره! و ویلیام می‌خواد دایناسور بشه!

branches.suggestion: Ha ha! A dinosaur isn't a job!
Rawr! Great job!

n8.speaker: mia
n8.text: Let's play jobs! I'm the astronaut, Nicola is the vet, and you're the pilot!

translations.fa: بیا شغل بازی کنیم! من فضانوردم، نیکولا دامپزشکه، و تو خلبانی!

branches.suggestion: OK! Welcome aboard!
Fasten your seatbelts!

n9.speaker: nicola
n9.text: Captain, can we fly to the moon? And can my dog come? He's poorly!

translations.fa: کاپیتان، می‌شه پرواز کنیم بریم ماه؟ و سگم هم بیاد؟ مریضه!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: I'm learning the days of the week! Monday, Tuesday… um… what's next?

translations.fa: دارم روزهای هفته را یاد می‌گیرم! دوشنبه، سه‌شنبه… اِم… بعدی چیه؟

branches.suggestion: Wednesday!
Is it Thursday?

cultureNote.en: In Britain the week usually starts on Monday on calendars.
cultureNote.fa: هفته در تقویم‌ها از دوشنبه شروع می‌شود.

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: Wednesday is a funny word. Wed-nes-day. Why is there a "d"?

translations.fa: چهارشنبه کلمهٔ بامزه‌ایه. Wed-nes-day. چرا یه «d» داره؟

branches.suggestion: Nobody knows! You don't say it.
English spelling is strange!

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday! Saturday and Sunday are the weekend. I love the weekend!

translations.fa: پنجشنبه، جمعه، شنبه، یکشنبه! شنبه و یکشنبه آخر هفته‌ان. عاشق آخر هفته‌ام!

branches.suggestion: Me too. No school!
In Iran, the weekend is Friday.

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: Friday? That's strange! What do you do on Fridays?

translations.fa: جمعه؟ عجیبه! جمعه‌ها چی کار می‌کنید؟

branches.suggestion: We visit family and have a big lunch.
branches.suggestionFa: به خانواده سر می‌زنیم و یه ناهار مفصل می‌خوریم.

branches.suggestion: We go to the mountains.

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: Mountains! On Saturdays I have ballet. What day is your English class?

translations.fa: کوه! من شنبه‌ها باله دارم. کلاس انگلیسیت چه روزیه؟

branches.suggestion: On Mondays and Wednesdays.
It's on Thursday evenings.

cultureNote.en: We say "ON Monday", "ON Saturdays" — not "in" or "at".
cultureNote.fa: با روزها از on استفاده کنید.

recasts.echo: On Mondays? Good!

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: What day is it today?

translations.fa: امروز چه روزیه؟

branches.suggestion: Today is Thursday.
I think it's Thursday.

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Thursday! Tomorrow is Friday! On Fridays we have fish and chips.

translations.fa: پنجشنبه! فردا جمعه‌ست! جمعه‌ها فیش اند چیپس داریم.

branches.suggestion: Every Friday?
I love fish and chips!

cultureNote.en: Friday fish and chips is an old British tradition.
cultureNote.fa: فیش اند چیپس جمعه‌ها سنت قدیمی است.

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Yes! Every Friday from the chippy. Daddy says it's the law!

translations.fa: آره! هر جمعه از چیپس‌فروشی. بابا می‌گه قانونه!

branches.suggestion: Ha ha! Your daddy is funny.
Can I come on Friday?

n9.speaker: nicola
n9.text: Yes, come on Friday! Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday! I did it!

translations.fa: آره، جمعه بیا! دوشنبه، سه‌شنبه، چهارشنبه، پنجشنبه، جمعه، شنبه، یکشنبه! تونستم!

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Oh no, it's Tuesday! It's bin day! The bin lorry comes at seven. Can you help me?

translations.fa: وای نه، سه‌شنبه‌ست! روز زباله‌ست! ماشین زباله ساعت هفت میاد. کمکم می‌کنی؟

branches.suggestion: Yes. What do I do?
Sure. Which bins?

cultureNote.en: British "bin lorry", American "garbage truck". British "rubbish", American "trash".
cultureNote.fa: bin lorry/garbage truck.

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: This week it's the black bin and the recycling. Next week, the green garden bin.

translations.fa: این هفته سطل مشکی و بازیافته. هفتهٔ بعد، سطل سبز باغچه.

branches.suggestion: Every week is different?
It's complicated!

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: It's very complicated! The council sends a calendar. It's on the fridge.

translations.fa: خیلی پیچیده‌ست! شورا یه تقویم می‌فرسته. رو یخچاله.

branches.suggestion: Let me check the calendar.
Good idea. A calendar helps.

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: Can you take the recycling box? Bottles, tins and paper go in there.

translations.fa: می‌تونی جعبهٔ بازیافت را ببری؟ بطری‌ها، قوطی‌ها و کاغذها می‌رن اونجا.

branches.suggestion: What about this pizza box?
Is this bottle OK?

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: Pizza box… it's greasy. Greasy boxes go in the black bin. Strange, but true!

translations.fa: جعبهٔ پیتزا… چربه. جعبه‌های چرب می‌رن تو سطل مشکی. عجیبه، ولی راسته!

branches.suggestion: I didn't know that!
OK. Black bin.

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: Take the bins to the front of the house. By the gate. Not in the road!

translations.fa: سطل‌ها را ببر جلوی خونه. کنار در حیاط. نه تو خیابون!

branches.suggestion: By the gate. Got it.
The bin is very heavy!

recasts.echo: It's very heavy? It's got wheels!

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: It's got wheels! Pull it. Look, there's the lorry! Just in time!

translations.fa: چرخ داره! بکشش. ببین، ماشین زباله اومد! درست به موقع!

branches.suggestion: Phew! Just in time!
Good morning!

n8.speaker: tom
n8.text: Morning, lads! Say thank you to the bin men. They do a hard job.

translations.fa: صبح بخیر بچه‌ها! از رفتگرها تشکر کن. کار سختی می‌کنن.

branches.suggestion: Thank you! Have a good day!
Cheers!

cultureNote.en: Many British families give the bin collectors a card or a tip at Christmas.
cultureNote.fa: کریسمس به رفتگرها کارت یا انعام می‌دهند.

n9.speaker: tom
n9.text: Great job. Same time next Tuesday! Now, back inside. It's freezing!

translations.fa: کارت عالی بود. سه‌شنبهٔ بعد همین موقع! حالا، برگردیم تو. یخ‌بندونه!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Our week is so busy! Let me tell you. On Mondays, Ryan has football practice.

translations.fa: هفتهٔ ما خیلی شلوغه! بذار برات بگم. دوشنبه‌ها، رایان تمرین فوتبال داره.

branches.suggestion: What time is football practice?
Every Monday?

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Every Monday at five. On Tuesdays, Nicola has swimming lessons.

translations.fa: هر دوشنبه ساعت پنج. سه‌شنبه‌ها، نیکولا کلاس شنا داره.

branches.suggestion: Can she swim?
Where are the lessons?

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: At the leisure centre. She can swim ten metres now! Can you swim?

translations.fa: تو مرکز تفریحی. الان می‌تونه ده متر شنا کنه! تو شنا بلدی؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I can swim.
Only a little.

cultureNote.en: British "leisure centre" = a public sports centre with a pool; "metre", American "meter".
cultureNote.fa: leisure centre مرکز ورزشی عمومی است.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: On Wednesdays, I have a staff meeting after school. Maggie picks up Nicola.

translations.fa: چهارشنبه‌ها بعد از مدرسه جلسهٔ کارکنان دارم. مگی نیکولا را برمی‌داره.

branches.suggestion: Maggie is very helpful.
Is the meeting long?

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Too long! On Thursdays, we go to the supermarket. Big shop!

translations.fa: خیلی طولانی! پنجشنبه‌ها، می‌ریم سوپرمارکت. خرید بزرگ!

branches.suggestion: Once a week?
That's a good idea.

recasts.echo: Once a week? Yes, every Thursday.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Yes, once a week. And Friday is fish and chips, of course! What do you do in a week?

translations.fa: آره، هفته‌ای یه بار. و جمعه هم فیش اند چیپس، البته! تو تو یه هفته چی کار می‌کنی؟

branches.suggestion: I have English class twice a week.
branches.suggestionFa: هفته‌ای دو بار کلاس انگلیسی دارم.

branches.suggestion: I go to the gym on Mondays and Fridays.

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Good for you! And at the weekend?

translations.fa: آفرین بهت! و آخر هفته؟

branches.suggestion: On Saturdays, I clean my flat.
On Sundays, I call my family.

cultureNote.en: British "flat", American "apartment".
cultureNote.fa: flat/apartment.

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: That's lovely. Every Sunday? Your mum must love that. Our Sundays are for a roast dinner — come and join us!

translations.fa: چه خوب. هر یکشنبه؟ مامانت حتماً خیلی دوست داره. یکشنبه‌های ما برای کباب یکشنبه‌ست — بیا پیشمون!

branches.suggestion: I'd love to. Thank you!
What time on Sunday?

n9.speaker: leslie
n9.text: Two o'clock. Bring your appetite! Tom makes the gravy, and he's very proud of it.

translations.fa: ساعت دو. با شکم گرسنه بیا! تام سس را درست می‌کنه، و خیلی بهش افتخار می‌کنه.

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Is it Wednesday today? I'm so tired, I can't remember!

translations.fa: امروز چهارشنبه‌ست؟ خیلی خسته‌ام، یادم نمیاد!

branches.suggestion: No, it's Thursday.
Yes, it's Wednesday.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Thursday! So yesterday was Wednesday. What's the date today?

translations.fa: پنجشنبه! پس دیروز چهارشنبه بود. امروز چندمه؟

branches.suggestion: It's the twelfth of March.
Let me look at my phone. The twelfth.

cultureNote.en: British people say "the twelfth of March" and write 12/03 — day first. Americans write 03/12.
cultureNote.fa: تاریخ بریتانیایی روز اول.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: The twelfth! Oh no! William's check-up is on the thirteenth. That's tomorrow!

translations.fa: دوازدهم! وای نه! معاینهٔ ویلیام سیزدهمه. یعنی فردا!

branches.suggestion: What time is it?
Don't worry. You remembered!

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Ten o'clock. And Saturday is the fifteenth. That's Nicola's party!

translations.fa: ساعت ده. و شنبه پونزدهمه. مهمونی نیکولاست!

branches.suggestion: A party? Whose party?
What kind of party?

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Her friend Mia's party. At the soft play centre. We need a present!

translations.fa: مهمونی دوستش میا. تو مرکز بازی سرپوشیده. یه کادو لازم داریم!

branches.suggestion: Shall we buy it tomorrow?
What does Mia like?

cultureNote.en: "Soft play" centres — indoor playgrounds with padded slides — are hugely popular for children's parties.
cultureNote.fa: مراکز بازی سرپوشیده برای جشن کودکان.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Space! She loves space. When is your birthday?

translations.fa: فضا! عاشق فضاست. تولد تو کِیه؟

branches.suggestion: My birthday is on the fifth of May.
It's in June. The twentieth.

recasts.echo: On the fifth of May? Lovely!
recasts.better: My birthday is on the fifth of May.

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: I'll write it on the calendar! We must have a cake. What day is it this year?

translations.fa: رو تقویم می‌نویسمش! باید کیک داشته باشیم. امسال چه روزیه؟

branches.suggestion: I don't know. Let's look.
I think it's a Sunday.

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: A Sunday! Perfect for a party. Now, what day is it today? Ha! Just joking. I need a cup of tea!

translations.fa: یکشنبه! برای مهمونی عالیه. حالا، امروز چه روزیه؟ ها! شوخی کردم. یه فنجون چای لازم دارم!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: My birthday is in July! It's in the summer. When's your birthday?

translations.fa: تولد من تو جولایه! تو تابستونه. تولد تو کِیه؟

branches.suggestion: My birthday is in May.
It's in December. In the winter.

cultureNote.en: Months take "in" (in May); dates take "on" (on the fifth of May).
cultureNote.fa: ماه با in، تاریخ با on.

recasts.echo: In May? That's spring!

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: May is in the spring! Spring has flowers and baby lambs.

translations.fa: مه تو بهاره! بهار گل و بره‌های کوچولو داره.

branches.suggestion: Do you like spring?
In Iran, spring is our new year!
branches.suggestionFa: تو ایران، بهار سال نوی ماست!

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: New year in spring? Our new year is in January. It's cold and dark!

translations.fa: سال نو تو بهار؟ سال نوی ما تو ژانویه‌ست. سرد و تاریکه!

branches.suggestion: Our new year is called Nowruz.
Spring is a nice time for a new year.
branches.suggestionFa: بهار وقت خوبی برای سال نوئه.

cultureNote.en: Nowruz, the Persian New Year, falls on the spring equinox, around the 20th or 21st of March.
cultureNote.fa: نوروز حدود ۲۰ یا ۲۱ مارس است.

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: Nowruz! What do you do at Nowruz?

translations.fa: نوروز! تو نوروز چی کار می‌کنید؟

branches.suggestion: We visit family and eat special food.
branches.suggestionFa: به خانواده سر می‌زنیم و غذای مخصوص می‌خوریم.

branches.suggestion: We put seven things on a table.
branches.suggestionFa: هفت تا چیز رو یه سفره می‌ذاریم.

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: Seven things! Can we do that here? I want a Nowruz table!

translations.fa: هفت تا چیز! می‌شه اینجا هم این کار را بکنیم؟ یه سفرهٔ نوروزی می‌خوام!

branches.suggestion: Yes! In March.
Of course. You can help me.

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: Yay! What month is it now?

translations.fa: هورا! الان چه ماهیه؟

branches.suggestion: October, I think.
Now it's October. It's autumn.

cultureNote.en: British "autumn", American "fall".
cultureNote.fa: autumn/fall.

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Autumn! The leaves are orange and brown. Look! Let's jump in the leaves!

translations.fa: پاییز! برگ‌ها نارنجی و قهوه‌ای‌ان. ببین! بیا بپریم تو برگ‌ها!

branches.suggestion: One, two, three, jump!
Wow, crunchy leaves!

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Wheee! What's your favourite month? Mine is July. Birthday and no school!

translations.fa: ویییی! ماه مورد علاقه‌ات چیه؟ مال من جولایه. تولد و بدون مدرسه!

branches.suggestion: I like March, because of Nowruz.
branches.suggestionFa: مارس را دوست دارم، به‌خاطر نوروز.

branches.suggestion: I like October. It's beautiful.

n9.speaker: nicola
n9.text: March and July and October! Let's have a party in every month! I'll ask Mummy!

translations.fa: مارس و جولای و اکتبر! بیا هر ماه یه مهمونی بگیریم! از مامان می‌پرسم!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Look at the trees! Autumn is my favourite season. Red, orange, yellow…

translations.fa: درخت‌ها را ببین! پاییز فصل مورد علاقهٔ منه. قرمز، نارنجی، زرد…

branches.suggestion: It's beautiful.
We have autumn in Iran, too.
branches.suggestionFa: ما هم تو ایران پاییز داریم.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: It's getting colder now. Have you got a warm coat?

translations.fa: الان داره سردتر میشه. یه کت گرم داری؟

branches.suggestion: Not yet. I need one.
Yes, I bought one last week.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: You need one! In November it's cold and wet. And the clocks go back.

translations.fa: لازمش داری! تو نوامبر سرد و خیسه. و ساعت‌ها عقب کشیده می‌شن.

branches.suggestion: What does "the clocks go back" mean?
Do the clocks change here?

cultureNote.en: In the UK the clocks go back one hour on the last Sunday of October and forward in late March.
cultureNote.fa: ساعت در اکتبر عقب و در مارس جلو می‌رود.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: One hour back in October. It gets dark at four o'clock! Very gloomy.

translations.fa: یه ساعت عقب تو اکتبر. ساعت چهار تاریک میشه! خیلی دلگیره.

branches.suggestion: Four o'clock? That's early!
I don't like dark evenings.

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Me neither. But autumn has good things too. Bonfire Night, and conkers!

translations.fa: منم همین‌طور. ولی پاییز چیزهای خوب هم داره. شب آتش‌بازی، و بلوط هندی!

branches.suggestion: What are conkers?
I love fireworks!

recasts.echo: What are conkers? Look!

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Look! These shiny brown nuts. Children play a game with them on a string.

translations.fa: ببین! این دونه‌های قهوه‌ای براق. بچه‌ها با نخ باهاشون بازی می‌کنن.

branches.suggestion: They're very shiny!
Can you eat them?

cultureNote.en: Conkers are horse chestnuts — you can't eat them! The game "conkers" is a classic British playground game.
cultureNote.fa: کانکر خوراکی نیست.

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: No! You can't eat them. They're poisonous. Sweet chestnuts are different.

translations.fa: نه! نمی‌شه خوردشون. سمی‌ان. شاه‌بلوط فرق داره.

branches.suggestion: Oh! Good to know.
In Iran we eat roasted chestnuts.

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Roasted chestnuts at Christmas! Lovely. Let's collect some conkers for Nicola.

translations.fa: شاه‌بلوط برشته تو کریسمس! عالی. بیا یه کم کانکر برای نیکولا جمع کنیم.

branches.suggestion: Here's a big one!
How many do we need?

n9.speaker: leslie
n9.text: That's a champion! Ten is enough. Now let's go home for hot chocolate. Autumn's best bit!

translations.fa: این قهرمانه! ده تا کافیه. حالا بریم خونه هات چاکلت بخوریم. بهترین بخش پاییز!

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Wake up! Look out of the window! It's snowing!

translations.fa: بیدار شو! از پنجره بیرون را ببین! داره برف میاد!

branches.suggestion: Wow! Snow!
Is it a lot of snow?

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: About ten centimetres! In London that's a lot. Everything stops!

translations.fa: حدود ده سانتی‌متر! تو لندن این زیاده. همه چی متوقف میشه!

branches.suggestion: Ten centimetres stops London?
branches.suggestionFa: ده سانت لندن را متوقف می‌کنه؟

branches.suggestion: Is school closed?

cultureNote.en: Britain rarely gets heavy snow, so even a little can close schools and delay trains — a "snow day"!
cultureNote.fa: برف کم هم مدارس را تعطیل می‌کند.

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: Yes! The school sent a text. It's a snow day! The kids are so happy.

translations.fa: آره! مدرسه پیامک داد. روز برفیه! بچه‌ها خیلی خوشحالن.

branches.suggestion: What about your bus?
Do you have work today?

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: My bus starts at ten today. Slowly, slowly! Let's build a snowman first.

translations.fa: اتوبوسم امروز ساعت ده شروع می‌کنه. یواش یواش! بیا اول یه آدم‌برفی بسازیم.

branches.suggestion: Great idea!
I've never built a snowman!

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: Never? Then today's the day! Put on your hat, scarf and gloves.

translations.fa: هیچ‌وقت؟ پس امروز روزشه! کلاه، شال‌گردن و دستکشت را بپوش.

branches.suggestion: Where are my gloves?
OK. And my boots!

recasts.echo: Put on your gloves? Yes, it's freezing!

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: Roll a big snowball for the body. Then a small one for the head.

translations.fa: یه گلوله برفی بزرگ برای بدن بغلتون. بعد یه کوچیک برای سر.

branches.suggestion: It's getting bigger and bigger!
My hands are freezing!

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: Now a carrot for the nose, and stones for the eyes. Nicola's bringing Daddy's old scarf.

translations.fa: حالا یه هویج برای دماغ، و سنگ برای چشما. نیکولا داره شال‌گردن قدیمی بابا را میاره.

branches.suggestion: He looks great!
What shall we call him?

n8.speaker: tom
n8.text: Nicola says his name is "Mr Frosty". Uh-oh… snowball fight! Ryan's coming! Run!

translations.fa: نیکولا می‌گه اسمش «آقای یخی»ـه. اوه اوه… جنگ گلوله‌برفی! رایان داره میاد! فرار کن!

branches.suggestion: Got you, Ryan!
Help! Not in my face!

n9.speaker: tom
n9.text: Ha ha! Brilliant! Right, everyone inside. Hot chocolate and dry socks! The best snow day ever!

translations.fa: ها ها! عالی! خب، همه برید تو. هات چاکلت و جوراب خشک! بهترین روز برفی!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: School finishes next week! Six weeks of summer holidays. The kids are so excited.

translations.fa: مدرسه هفتهٔ دیگه تموم میشه! شش هفته تعطیلات تابستونی. بچه‌ها خیلی هیجان‌زده‌ان.

branches.suggestion: Six weeks? That's long!
What are you going to do?

cultureNote.en: In England, the summer holidays usually last about six weeks, from late July to early September.
cultureNote.fa: تعطیلات تابستان حدود شش هفته است.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: We're going to go to the seaside in August. To Cornwall! Have you been?

translations.fa: قراره آگوست بریم کنار دریا. به کورنوال! رفتی تا حالا؟

branches.suggestion: No, never. Is it nice?
Where is Cornwall?

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: It's in the south-west. Beautiful beaches! But it often rains.

translations.fa: تو جنوب‌غربیه. ساحل‌های قشنگ! ولی اغلب بارون میاد.

branches.suggestion: Rain in summer?
Take an umbrella!

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Always! British summer is a surprise. Some days it's thirty degrees, some days it's fifteen.

translations.fa: همیشه! تابستون بریتانیا غافلگیرکننده‌ست. بعضی روزها سی درجه‌ست، بعضی روزها پونزده.

branches.suggestion: That's very different!
In Tehran it's hot every day.

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Every day? Lucky you! What are you going to do in the summer?

translations.fa: هر روز؟ خوش به حالت! تو تابستون قراره چی کار کنی؟

branches.suggestion: I'm going to visit my family.
I'm going to study English.

recasts.echo: You're going to visit your family? Wonderful!
recasts.better: I'm going to visit my family.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: That's wonderful. Will you go to Iran?

translations.fa: فوق‌العاده‌ست. می‌ری ایران؟

branches.suggestion: Maybe. Flights are expensive.
My mother is going to come here.

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Oh, how lovely! She must come for tea. Nicola wants to go camping, and Ryan wants to sleep all summer!

translations.fa: آه، چه خوب! حتماً باید برای چای بیاد. نیکولا می‌خواد بره کمپینگ، و رایان می‌خواد کل تابستون بخوابه!

branches.suggestion: Camping is fun!
Ha ha! Typical teenager!

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Very typical! I'm going to read lots of books and drink lots of tea in the garden. That's my perfect summer!

translations.fa: خیلی معمولی! من قراره کلی کتاب بخونم و کلی چای تو باغ بخورم. این تابستون عالی منه!

n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: Mum says I need a new winter coat. My old one is too small. Can you help me choose?

translations.fa: مامان می‌گه یه کت زمستونی جدید لازم دارم. قدیمیه خیلی کوچیکه. کمکم می‌کنی انتخاب کنم؟

branches.suggestion: Sure. What kind of coat do you want?
Of course. Let's look at the coats.

n2.speaker: ryan
n2.text: Something warm. And cool! Not like Dad's anorak. What about this black one?

translations.fa: یه چیز گرم. و باحال! نه مثل بادگیر بابا. این مشکیه چطوره؟

branches.suggestion: It looks warm.
I like the green one.

cultureNote.en: An "anorak" is a waterproof jacket — but calling someone "an anorak" means they're a bit of a nerd!
cultureNote.fa: anorak همچنین یعنی آدم خوره‌ی یک موضوع.

n3.speaker: ryan
n3.text: Green? Hmm. Let's ask. Excuse me, have you got this in green?

translations.fa: سبز؟ هوم. بیا بپرسیم. ببخشید، اینو سبز دارید؟

branches.suggestion: Good idea. Ask her.
I'll ask. Excuse me!

n4.speaker: priya
n4.text: Let me check. Yes, we've got it in green and navy. What size are you?

translations.fa: بذارید چک کنم. آره، سبز و سورمه‌ای داریم. سایزتون چنده؟

branches.suggestion: He's a medium, I think.
What sizes have you got?

n5.speaker: priya
n5.text: Small, medium and large. Try the medium. The changing rooms are over there.

translations.fa: کوچیک، متوسط و بزرگ. مدیوم را امتحان کنید. اتاق پرو اونجاست.

branches.suggestion: Thank you.
Go on, Ryan, try it on!

n6.speaker: ryan
n6.text: What do you think? Is it OK?

translations.fa: نظرت چیه؟ خوبه؟

branches.suggestion: It looks great on you!
The sleeves are a bit long.

recasts.echo: It looks great? Thanks!

n7.speaker: ryan
n7.text: The sleeves are long, but Mum says I'm growing. How much is it?

translations.fa: آستین‌ها بلنده، ولی مامان می‌گه دارم بزرگ میشم. قیمتش چنده؟

branches.suggestion: Let me look at the label. It's forty pounds.
branches.suggestionFa: بذار برچسبش را ببینم. چهل پونده.

branches.suggestion: Ask the shop assistant.

n8.speaker: priya
n8.text: It's forty pounds, but it's twenty percent off today. Thirty-two pounds!

translations.fa: چهل پونده، ولی امروز بیست درصد تخفیف داره. سی و دو پوند!

branches.suggestion: That's a good price!
Twenty percent off? Brilliant!

cultureNote.en: "20% off" means a 20% discount. A "sale" is when many things are cheaper.
cultureNote.fa: 20% off یعنی ۲۰ درصد تخفیف.

n9.speaker: ryan
n9.text: Mum gave me forty quid. So I've got eight pounds left. Can I buy a hat too?

translations.fa: مامان چهل پوند بهم داد. پس هشت پوند برام می‌مونه. می‌تونم یه کلاه هم بخرم؟

branches.suggestion: Ask your mum first!
A hat is a good idea. It's cold.

n10.speaker: ryan
n10.text: I'll text her. She says yes — but give her the receipt! Thanks for helping, mate. You've got good taste.

translations.fa: بهش پیام می‌دم. می‌گه آره — ولی رسید را بهش بدم! ممنون که کمک کردی رفیق. سلیقه‌ات خوبه.

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: I need a dress for a wedding. Ugh, I hate shopping for dresses! Will you help me?

translations.fa: یه لباس برای عروسی لازم دارم. اه، از خرید لباس متنفرم! کمکم می‌کنی؟

branches.suggestion: Of course. Whose wedding is it?
Yes! What colour do you want?

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: My cousin's wedding. In June. Not white — only the bride wears white!

translations.fa: عروسی دخترخاله‌ام. تو ژوئن. نه سفید — فقط عروس سفید می‌پوشه!

branches.suggestion: What about blue?
This red one is pretty.

cultureNote.en: At British weddings, guests usually avoid wearing white, so they don't compete with the bride.
cultureNote.fa: مهمان‌ها سفید نمی‌پوشند.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Ooh, blue is nice. Excuse me, do you have this in a size twelve?

translations.fa: اوه، آبی قشنگه. ببخشید، اینو سایز دوازده دارید؟

branches.suggestion: I hope they've got a twelve.
Let's ask the assistant.

n4.speaker: priya
n4.text: Size twelve… I'm sorry, we've only got a ten and a fourteen.

translations.fa: سایز دوازده… متأسفم، فقط ده و چهارده داریم.

branches.suggestion: Try the fourteen?
Can you order a twelve?

cultureNote.en: UK women's sizes (8, 10, 12…) are different from US sizes (a UK 12 is about a US 8).
cultureNote.fa: سایزهای بریتانیا با آمریکا فرق دارد.

n5.speaker: priya
n5.text: Yes, we can order it online. It arrives in three days. Or try the fourteen with a belt?

translations.fa: آره، می‌تونیم آنلاین سفارشش بدیم. سه روزه می‌رسه. یا چهارده را با کمربند امتحان کنید؟

branches.suggestion: Let's try the fourteen first.
branches.suggestionFa: بیا اول چهارده را امتحان کنیم.

branches.suggestion: Three days is fine.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: OK, I'll try the fourteen. How does it look? Be honest!

translations.fa: باشه، چهارده را امتحان می‌کنم. چطوره؟ صادق باش!

branches.suggestion: It's a bit big.
The colour is lovely, but it's too long.

recasts.echo: A bit big? Yes, I think so too.

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Yes, too big. OK, let's order the twelve. Can I pay now?

translations.fa: آره، خیلی بزرگه. باشه، دوازده را سفارش بدیم. می‌تونم الان پرداخت کنم؟

branches.suggestion: Good choice.
Yes, pay at the till.

n8.speaker: priya
n8.text: Yes. It's forty-five pounds. Can I take your name and phone number?

translations.fa: بله. چهل و پنج پونده. اسم و شماره تلفنتون را می‌دید؟

branches.suggestion: Her name is Leslie Thompson.
Shall I spell it for you?

n9.speaker: leslie
n9.text: Leslie Thompson, 07700 900123. Thank you! Now I need shoes. Oh no, more shopping!

translations.fa: لزلی تامپسون، ۰۷۷۰۰ ۹۰۰۱۲۳. ممنون! حالا کفش لازم دارم. وای نه، خرید بیشتر!

branches.suggestion: Shall we have a coffee first?
Come on, you can do it!

n10.speaker: leslie
n10.text: Coffee first, definitely! Then shoes. Thank you for your patience, love. You're a star!

translations.fa: اول قهوه، حتماً! بعد کفش. ممنون از صبرت عزیزم. تو یه ستاره‌ای!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: My school shoes hurt! My toes are squashed! Mummy says new shoes today.

translations.fa: کفش‌های مدرسه‌ام درد می‌کنن! انگشتای پام له شدن! مامان می‌گه امروز کفش نو.

branches.suggestion: Let's find some new ones.
branches.suggestionFa: بیا یه جفت نو پیدا کنیم.

branches.suggestion: Your feet are growing!

n2.speaker: priya
n2.text: Hello, young lady! Shall we measure your feet? Put your foot here.

translations.fa: سلام خانم کوچولو! پاهات را اندازه بگیریم؟ پات را بذار اینجا.

branches.suggestion: Go on, Nicola. Put your foot on it.
branches.suggestionFa: برو نیکولا. پات را بذار روش.

branches.suggestion: Is it a machine?

cultureNote.en: Many British shoe shops measure children's feet for length and width before selling school shoes.
cultureNote.fa: فروشگاه‌ها پای کودک را اندازه می‌گیرند.

n3.speaker: priya
n3.text: Size eleven! She was a ten. What colour would you like, Nicola?

translations.fa: سایز یازده! قبلاً ده بود. چه رنگی می‌خوای نیکولا؟

branches.suggestion: Which colour, Nicola?
Eleven! You're growing fast.

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: Pink with lights! Shoes with lights are the best!

translations.fa: صورتی با چراغ! کفش چراغ‌دار بهترینه!

branches.suggestion: School shoes must be black, Nicola.
branches.suggestionFa: کفش مدرسه باید مشکی باشه نیکولا.

branches.suggestion: Lights at school? I don't think so!

n5.speaker: priya
n5.text: For school, black is best. Try these black ones with a sparkle on the side.

translations.fa: برای مدرسه، مشکی بهتره. اینای مشکی که کنارش برق می‌زنه را امتحان کن.

branches.suggestion: They're nice, Nicola!
Can she walk in them?

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: They're too tight! They hurt!

translations.fa: خیلی تنگن! درد می‌کنن!

branches.suggestion: Try a bigger size.
Can she try an eleven and a half?
branches.suggestionFa: می‌شه یازده و نیم را امتحان کنه؟

recasts.echo: They're too tight? Let's try another.

n7.speaker: priya
n7.text: Here's eleven and a half. How do they feel? Walk to the mirror.

translations.fa: اینم یازده و نیم. چطورن؟ تا آینه راه برو.

branches.suggestion: Walk to the mirror, Nicola.
Are they better?

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Better! They're comfy! Look, they sparkle!

translations.fa: بهتره! راحتن! ببین، برق می‌زنن!

branches.suggestion: Perfect! Do you like them?
Can you jump in them?

n9.speaker: priya
n9.text: Good. There's room to grow. That's thirty-five pounds, please.

translations.fa: خوبه. جا برای بزرگ شدن داره. سی و پنج پوند میشه، لطفاً.

branches.suggestion: Here you are.
Can I pay by card?

n10.speaker: nicola
n10.text: Thank you! Can I wear them now? Bye-bye, old shoes! My toes are happy!

translations.fa: ممنون! می‌تونم الان بپوشمشون؟ خداحافظ کفش‌های قدیمی! انگشتای پام خوشحالن!

n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: Nana bought me this jumper for my birthday. It's lovely, but it's massive! Can you come with me to change it?

translations.fa: نانا برای تولدم این ژاکت را خرید. قشنگه، ولی خیلی بزرگه! باهام میای عوضش کنیم؟

branches.suggestion: Sure. Have you got the receipt?
It's huge! Let's go.

cultureNote.en: British "jumper" = American "sweater".
cultureNote.fa: jumper/sweater.

n2.speaker: ryan
n2.text: Yes, Nana gave me a gift receipt. Excuse me, can I change this, please?

translations.fa: آره، نانا یه رسید هدیه بهم داد. ببخشید، می‌شه اینو عوض کنم، لطفاً؟

branches.suggestion: Good. Ask the lady over there.
branches.suggestionFa: خوبه. از اون خانم اونجا بپرس.

branches.suggestion: I'll come with you to the till.

n3.speaker: priya
n3.text: Of course. What's wrong with it?

translations.fa: البته. مشکلش چیه؟

branches.suggestion: It's too big for him.
He needs a smaller size.

cultureNote.en: A "gift receipt" lets someone return or exchange a present without seeing the price.
cultureNote.fa: رسید هدیه بدون قیمت.

n4.speaker: priya
n4.text: It's an extra large. Do you want a medium?

translations.fa: این ایکس‌لارجه. مدیوم می‌خواید؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, a medium, please.
Try a small and a medium.
branches.suggestionFa: کوچیک و متوسط را امتحان کن.

n5.speaker: priya
n5.text: Here's a medium. The changing rooms are on the left.

translations.fa: اینم مدیوم. اتاق پرو سمت چپه.

branches.suggestion: Thank you. Go on, Ryan.
On the left? Thanks.

n6.speaker: ryan
n6.text: Hmm. The medium is too small. My arms are long!

translations.fa: هوم. مدیوم خیلی کوچیکه. دستام بلندن!

branches.suggestion: Try the large, then.
Not too big, not too small…
branches.suggestionFa: نه خیلی بزرگ، نه خیلی کوچیک…

n7.speaker: ryan
n7.text: The large is just right! Like Goldilocks! Ha.

translations.fa: لارج درست اندازه‌ست! مثل موطلایی! ها.

branches.suggestion: It looks good on you.
Nana will be happy.

n8.speaker: priya
n8.text: Lovely. Same price, so it's a simple swap. Would you like a bag?

translations.fa: عالی. همون قیمته، پس یه تعویض سادست. کیسه می‌خواید؟

branches.suggestion: No, thanks. He's going to wear it!
Yes, please.

recasts.echo: The same price? Yes, no extra to pay.

n9.speaker: ryan
n9.text: Can you take a photo of me for Nana? I'll send it to her. She'll love it.

translations.fa: می‌تونی یه عکس ازم برای نانا بگیری؟ براش می‌فرستم. خیلی خوشش میاد.

branches.suggestion: Smile! Say cheese!
One, two, three… lovely!

cultureNote.en: English speakers say "Say cheese!" for photos; Persian speakers often say "سیب".
cultureNote.fa: Say cheese برای عکس.

n10.speaker: ryan
n10.text: Nana's replied already! "Handsome boy! Don't get it muddy at football!" Ha! She knows me too well.

translations.fa: نانا جواب داد! «پسر خوش‌تیپ! سر فوتبال گِلیش نکنی!» ها! خیلی خوب منو می‌شناسه.

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Nicola came home from school very quiet today. She's sitting on the sofa. Can you talk to her?

translations.fa: نیکولا امروز خیلی ساکت از مدرسه اومد. رو مبل نشسته. می‌تونی باهاش حرف بزنی؟

branches.suggestion: Of course. Hi, Nicola. Are you OK?
Is she sad?

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: I'm sad. My best friend Mia played with Lily today. Not with me.

translations.fa: ناراحتم. بهترین دوستم میا امروز با لیلی بازی کرد. نه با من.

branches.suggestion: Oh, I'm sorry. That's hard.
How do you feel now?

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: I feel lonely. And a bit angry.

translations.fa: احساس تنهایی می‌کنم. و یه کم عصبانی.

branches.suggestion: It's OK to feel angry.
I understand. I feel lonely sometimes too.
branches.suggestionFa: می‌فهمم. منم گاهی احساس تنهایی می‌کنم.

match: i feel lonely too sometimes me
recasts.echo: You feel lonely sometimes? Me too.

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: Do you? Why?

translations.fa: واقعاً؟ چرا؟

branches.suggestion: Because my family is far away.
Because I'm in a new country.

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: That's sad. But you've got us now! We're like your family.

translations.fa: این غم‌انگیزه. ولی حالا ما را داری! ما مثل خانواده‌تیم.

branches.suggestion: Thank you, Nicola. That makes me happy.
You're very kind.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Maybe Mia wanted to play with Lily just today. Tomorrow you can play together.

translations.fa: شاید میا فقط امروز می‌خواست با لیلی بازی کنه. فردا می‌تونید با هم بازی کنید.

branches.suggestion: You can all play together!
branches.suggestionFa: همه‌تون می‌تونید با هم بازی کنید!

branches.suggestion: Ask Mia tomorrow, Nicola.

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: All three of us? Me, Mia and Lily? Hmm… OK. Lily is nice, actually.

translations.fa: هر سه‌مون؟ من، میا و لیلی؟ هوم… باشه. راستش لیلی مهربونه.

branches.suggestion: That's a great idea!
How do you feel now?

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Better! I feel happy again. Can we have a hug?

translations.fa: بهتر! دوباره خوشحالم. می‌شه بغلت کنم؟

branches.suggestion: Of course! A big hug!
Come here!

n9.speaker: leslie
n9.text: Ahh. Thank you, love. You're very good at this. Hot chocolate for everyone, I think!

translations.fa: آه. ممنون عزیزم. تو این کار خیلی خوبی. فکر کنم هات چاکلت برای همه!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: I can't sleep. I'm scared. It's very dark in my room.

translations.fa: خوابم نمی‌بره. می‌ترسم. اتاقم خیلی تاریکه.

branches.suggestion: Don't be scared, Nicola.
What are you scared of?

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: Of monsters. Under my bed! I heard a noise.

translations.fa: از هیولاها. زیر تختم! یه صدایی شنیدم.

branches.suggestion: Let's look under the bed together.
branches.suggestionFa: بیا با هم زیر تخت را نگاه کنیم.

branches.suggestion: There are no monsters, I promise.

recasts.echo: No monsters? That's right!

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: OK… Can you see anything?

translations.fa: باشه… چیزی می‌بینی؟

branches.suggestion: Only a sock and a teddy.
branches.suggestionFa: فقط یه جوراب و یه عروسک.

branches.suggestion: Just your slippers!

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: Mr Buttons! My teddy! He fell off the bed. That was the noise!

translations.fa: آقای دکمه! خرسم! از تخت افتاد. اون صدا بود!

branches.suggestion: Here he is. He's safe now.
Mystery solved!

n5.speaker: weda
n5.text: What's all this? Nicola, are you still awake? It's nine o'clock!

translations.fa: این‌ها چیه؟ نیکولا، هنوز بیداری؟ ساعت نهه!

branches.suggestion: She was a bit scared, Maggie.
We found Mr Buttons under the bed.
branches.suggestionFa: آقای دکمه را زیر تخت پیدا کردیم.

n6.speaker: weda
n6.text: Oh, sweetheart. Shall I leave the landing light on? And the door open a little?

translations.fa: آه، عزیزدلم. چراغ راهروی بالا را روشن بذارم؟ و در را یه کم باز؟

branches.suggestion: That's a good idea.
Do you want a night light, Nicola?

cultureNote.en: The "landing" is the hallway at the top of the stairs in a British house.
cultureNote.fa: landing یعنی راهروی بالای پله.

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Yes, please. Nana, were you scared of the dark when you were little?

translations.fa: آره، لطفاً. نانا، تو بچگی از تاریکی می‌ترسیدی؟

branches.suggestion: What a good question!
I was scared of the dark too.

n8.speaker: weda
n8.text: Oh yes. I was scared of thunder too. My mum sang to me. Shall I sing to you?

translations.fa: آه آره. از رعد و برق هم می‌ترسیدم. مامانم برام آواز می‌خوند. برات آواز بخونم؟

branches.suggestion: Yes! Sing a song, Maggie.
That's lovely.

n9.speaker: weda
n9.text: "Hush, little baby, don't say a word…" Look, she's asleep already. Thank you, love. Night night.

translations.fa: «هیس، بچه کوچولو، هیچی نگو…» ببین، خوابش برد. ممنون عزیزم. شب بخیر.

n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: Leave me alone. I'm in a bad mood.

translations.fa: ولم کن. حالم خوب نیست.

branches.suggestion: OK. But what's wrong?
Do you want to talk about it?

n2.speaker: ryan
n2.text: Everything! I lost my phone, I got a detention, and we lost the football match.

translations.fa: همه چی! گوشیم را گم کردم، تنبیه شدم، و مسابقهٔ فوتبال را باختیم.

branches.suggestion: Oh dear. That's a bad day!
A detention? Why?

cultureNote.en: A "detention" means staying at school after lessons as a punishment.
cultureNote.fa: detention یعنی ماندن در مدرسه بعد از کلاس.

n3.speaker: ryan
n3.text: I forgot my homework. Again. I'm so fed up!

translations.fa: تکلیفم را یادم رفت. دوباره. خیلی خسته شدم!

branches.suggestion: Everyone forgets sometimes.
I understand. You feel fed up.

n4.speaker: ryan
n4.text: And my phone! All my photos are on it. Mum is going to be so angry.

translations.fa: و گوشیم! همهٔ عکس‌هام روشه. مامان خیلی عصبانی میشه.

branches.suggestion: Where did you last see it?
Let's call it. Maybe we can hear it.
branches.suggestionFa: بیا بهش زنگ بزنیم. شاید صداش را بشنویم.

n5.speaker: ryan
n5.text: Good idea. Call it! My number is in your phone, right?

translations.fa: فکر خوبیه. زنگ بزن! شماره‌ام تو گوشیته، درسته؟

branches.suggestion: Yes. Calling now…
Shh! Listen!

n6.speaker: ryan
n6.text: I can hear it! It's ringing… in my football bag! I'm such an idiot.

translations.fa: صداش را می‌شنوم! داره زنگ می‌زنه… تو کیف فوتبالم! چه احمقی‌ام.

branches.suggestion: You're not an idiot!
Ha! One problem fixed!

recasts.echo: You're not an idiot? Exactly!

n7.speaker: ryan
n7.text: Thanks. OK, one problem fixed. The match… we lost five–nil. It was embarrassing.

translations.fa: ممنون. خب، یه مشکل حل شد. مسابقه… پنج هیچ باختیم. خجالت‌آور بود.

branches.suggestion: Five–nil? Ouch!
There's always next week.

cultureNote.en: In British football scores, "nil" means zero: "five–nil".
cultureNote.fa: nil یعنی صفر.

n8.speaker: ryan
n8.text: True. And the homework… I'll do it now. Before tea. Thanks for listening, mate. I feel a bit better.

translations.fa: درسته. و تکلیف… الان انجامش می‌دم. قبل از شام. ممنون که گوش دادی رفیق. یه کم حالم بهتر شد.

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: You look a bit down today. Are you OK, love?

translations.fa: امروز یه کم دمغی. خوبی عزیزم؟

branches.suggestion: I'm a bit homesick.
I'm fine, just tired.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Homesick. That's normal. You're a long way from home. What do you miss?

translations.fa: دلتنگ وطن. طبیعیه. خیلی از خونه دوری. دلت برای چی تنگ شده؟

branches.suggestion: I miss my mum's cooking.
branches.suggestionFa: دلم برای دستپخت مامانم تنگ شده.

branches.suggestion: I miss my friends.

match: i am missing my mother cooking
recasts.echo: You miss your mum's cooking? Of course.
recasts.betterFa: دلم برای دستپخت مامانم تنگ شده.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Of course. Why don't you call her tonight?

translations.fa: البته. چرا امشب بهش زنگ نمی‌زنی؟

branches.suggestion: Good idea. It's evening in Tehran.
I call her every Sunday.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Lovely. And how about cooking a Persian dish here? You can teach us!

translations.fa: عالی. و چطوره اینجا یه غذای ایرانی بپزی؟ می‌تونی به ما یاد بدی!

branches.suggestion: Really? That would be fun!
I can make ghormeh sabzi.

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Ghormeh sabzi! What's in it?

translations.fa: قرمه‌سبزی! توش چیه؟

branches.suggestion: Herbs, beans, meat and dried lemons.
branches.suggestionFa: سبزی، لوبیا، گوشت و لیمو عمانی.

branches.suggestion: Lots of green herbs. It's delicious!

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: It sounds amazing. Let's go to the Persian shop on Saturday. Is there one near here?

translations.fa: خیلی عالی به نظر میاد. بیا شنبه بریم مغازهٔ ایرانی. اینجا نزدیک هست؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, there's one on the high street.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، یکی تو خیابون اصلی هست.

branches.suggestion: I think there's one in north London.
branches.suggestionFa: فکر کنم یکی تو شمال لندن هست.

cultureNote.en: London has many Persian shops and restaurants, especially in Kensington and north-west London.
cultureNote.fa: لندن مغازه‌های ایرانی زیادی دارد.

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Perfect. Now let's go for a walk. Fresh air helps.

translations.fa: عالی. حالا بیا بریم قدم بزنیم. هوای تازه کمک می‌کنه.

branches.suggestion: OK. Let me get my coat.
Can William come too?

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Of course! And we'll get a cake on the way back. Cheer up, love — you've got a family here too.

translations.fa: البته! و تو راه برگشت یه کیک می‌گیریم. شاد باش عزیزم — اینجا هم خانواده داری.

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: You've got a job interview today! Big day! What are you going to wear?

translations.fa: امروز مصاحبهٔ کاری داری! روز بزرگیه! قراره چی بپوشی؟

branches.suggestion: I don't know. Can you help me?
A shirt and trousers, I think.
branches.suggestionFa: فکر کنم یه پیراهن و شلوار.

cultureNote.en: British "trousers" = American "pants".
cultureNote.fa: trousers/pants.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Let's see. Is it an office job?

translations.fa: ببینیم. کار دفتریه؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, in a big office.
No, it's in a shop.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Then a shirt is good. Blue or white? Should you wear a tie?

translations.fa: پس پیراهن خوبه. آبی یا سفید؟ کراوات بزنی؟

branches.suggestion: Should I wear a tie?
I haven't got a tie.

cultureNote.en: Many British offices are now "smart casual" — a smart shirt, no tie.
cultureNote.fa: بسیاری از دفاتر رسمی-راحت هستند.

recasts.echo: Should you wear a tie? Maybe not.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: No tie is fine these days. Smart but relaxed. Is your shirt ironed?

translations.fa: این روزها بدون کراوات اشکال نداره. شیک ولی راحت. پیراهنت اتو شده؟

branches.suggestion: No. Can I borrow your iron?
branches.suggestionFa: نه. می‌تونم اتوت را قرض بگیرم؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I ironed it last night.

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: The iron's in the cupboard. And what about a jumper? It's chilly today.

translations.fa: اتو تو کمده. و ژاکت چی؟ امروز هوا سرده.

branches.suggestion: A dark blue jumper?
I'll take my coat instead.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Good. Navy is smart. Now — shoes! Not trainers.

translations.fa: خوبه. سورمه‌ای شیکه. حالا — کفش! نه کتونی.

branches.suggestion: I've got black shoes.
Are trainers really bad?

cultureNote.en: British "trainers" = American "sneakers".
cultureNote.fa: trainers/sneakers.

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: For an interview, yes! Black shoes are perfect. Clean them first!

translations.fa: برای مصاحبه، آره! کفش مشکی عالیه. اول تمیزشون کن!

branches.suggestion: OK. Where's the shoe polish?
They're clean. I cleaned them yesterday.

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Look at you! Very smart. Good luck! You'll be brilliant.

translations.fa: خودت را ببین! خیلی شیک. موفق باشی! عالی می‌شی.

branches.suggestion: Thank you, Leslie. I'm nervous!
Thanks for your help!

n9.speaker: leslie
n9.text: Everyone's nervous. Smile, say hello, and be yourself. Text me after!

translations.fa: همه استرس دارن. لبخند بزن، سلام کن، و خودت باش. بعدش بهم پیام بده!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: I can't do up my coat! The zip is stuck!

translations.fa: نمی‌تونم کتم را ببندم! زیپش گیر کرده!

branches.suggestion: Let me help you.
Pull it gently.

cultureNote.en: British "zip", American "zipper".
cultureNote.fa: zip/zipper.

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: It won't go up. Can you do it?

translations.fa: بالا نمی‌ره. تو می‌تونی؟

branches.suggestion: There! It's done.
Wait… the zip is broken.

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: Yay! Thank you! Now my cardigan. It's got big buttons.

translations.fa: هورا! ممنون! حالا ژاکت دکمه‌دارم. دکمه‌های بزرگ داره.

branches.suggestion: Can you do the buttons?
One button at a time.

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: One, two, three… oh no! It's wrong!

translations.fa: یک، دو، سه… وای نه! اشتباهه!

branches.suggestion: You missed one. Start again.
branches.suggestionFa: یکی را جا انداختی. از اول شروع کن.

branches.suggestion: Ha ha! It's crooked!

recasts.echo: You missed one? Let's start again.

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: Again… one, two, three, four, five! Done!

translations.fa: دوباره… یک، دو، سه، چهار، پنج! تموم!

branches.suggestion: Well done! You did it!
Perfect. Now your shoes.

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: My shoes have Velcro. I can do Velcro! Rip, stick!

translations.fa: کفشام چسبی‌ان. چسبی را بلدم! ریپ، چسب!

branches.suggestion: That's easy!
Can you tie laces?

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Not yet. Ryan says "bunny ears". Can you show me?

translations.fa: هنوز نه. رایان می‌گه «گوش خرگوشی». نشونم می‌دی؟

branches.suggestion: Make two loops, like bunny ears.
branches.suggestionFa: دو تا حلقه درست کن، مثل گوش خرگوش.

branches.suggestion: Cross them over and pull.

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Like this? Two loops… cross… pull! I did a bow!

translations.fa: این‌جوری؟ دو تا حلقه… ضربدر… بکش! یه پاپیون درست کردم!

branches.suggestion: Brilliant, Nicola!
You're a fast learner!

n9.speaker: nicola
n9.text: I'm a big girl now! Mummy, look! I did my zip, my buttons and a bow!

translations.fa: من الان دختر بزرگی‌ام! مامان، ببین! زیپم، دکمه‌هام و یه پاپیون را خودم بستم!

n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: Is it "Odd Socks Day" at school today? Mum says it is. Do you know about it?

translations.fa: امروز تو مدرسه «روز جوراب لنگه به لنگه»ست؟ مامان می‌گه هست. چیزی دربارهش می‌دونی؟

branches.suggestion: No. What is it?
Odd socks? What does "odd" mean?
branches.suggestionFa: جوراب لنگه به لنگه؟ «اود» یعنی چی؟

n2.speaker: ryan
n2.text: Odd means they don't match. Two different socks! It's for anti-bullying week.

translations.fa: اود یعنی جور نیستن. دو تا جوراب متفاوت! برای هفتهٔ مبارزه با قلدریه.

branches.suggestion: What a nice idea!
Why odd socks?

cultureNote.en: "Odd Socks Day" in the UK celebrates being different, during Anti-Bullying Week in November.
cultureNote.fa: روز جوراب ناجور برای احترام به تفاوت‌ها.

n3.speaker: ryan
n3.text: Because we're all different. And that's OK! So, which socks? Help me choose.

translations.fa: چون همه‌مون فرق داریم. و اشکالی نداره! خب، کدوم جوراب‌ها؟ کمکم کن انتخاب کنم.

branches.suggestion: One red and one with stripes.
This yellow one and that green one.

n4.speaker: ryan
n4.text: Stripes! Nice. And this one has got dinosaurs on it. It's Nicola's old one!

translations.fa: راه‌راه! خوبه. و این یکی دایناسور داره. مال قدیمی نیکولاست!

branches.suggestion: It's too small for you!
Dinosaurs are cool!

n5.speaker: ryan
n5.text: Ha! It doesn't fit. OK, red and stripes. Do my trousers match my jumper?

translations.fa: ها! اندازه‌م نیست. باشه، قرمز و راه‌راه. شلوارم به ژاکتم میاد؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, they go well together.
Not really. Grey and brown?

recasts.echo: They go well together? Yes, they do.

n6.speaker: ryan
n6.text: It's school uniform! Grey trousers, black jumper. Everyone looks the same.

translations.fa: لباس فرم مدرسه‌ست! شلوار طوسی، ژاکت مشکی. همه شکل همن.

branches.suggestion: Except for the socks today!
Do all British schools have uniforms?
branches.suggestionFa: همهٔ مدرسه‌های بریتانیا لباس فرم دارن؟

cultureNote.en: Most British schools have a uniform, often with a blazer and a school tie.
cultureNote.fa: بیشتر مدارس بریتانیا لباس فرم دارند.

n7.speaker: ryan
n7.text: Most do. My school has a tie too. I hate ties! Do you wear odd socks sometimes?

translations.fa: بیشترشون. مدرسهٔ من کراوات هم داره. از کراوات متنفرم! تو گاهی جوراب ناجور می‌پوشی؟

branches.suggestion: Every day! I can never find a pair.
branches.suggestionFa: هر روز! هیچ‌وقت یه جفت پیدا نمی‌کنم.

branches.suggestion: No, I always wear matching socks.

n8.speaker: ryan
n8.text: Ha! Every day is Odd Socks Day for you! Right, I'm late. Socks on, tie on — bye!

translations.fa: ها! هر روز برای تو روز جوراب ناجوره! خب، دیرم شد. جوراب پام، کراوات گردنم — خداحافظ!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: It's pouring with rain! But we must walk to school. Everyone, wellies on!

translations.fa: داره سیل‌آسا بارون میاد! ولی باید پیاده بریم مدرسه. همه چکمه‌هاتون را بپوشید!

branches.suggestion: What are wellies?
Where are my wellies?

cultureNote.en: "Wellies" (Wellington boots) are rubber boots — named after the Duke of Wellington.
cultureNote.fa: ولی‌ها چکمه‌های لاستیکی‌اند.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Rubber boots! Yours are by the door. Nicola, put your raincoat on, please.

translations.fa: چکمه‌های لاستیکی! مال تو کنار دره. نیکولا، بارونیت را بپوش، لطفاً.

branches.suggestion: Nicola, here's your raincoat.
Is it the yellow one?

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Yes, the yellow one with the hood. And William needs his rain cover on the buggy.

translations.fa: آره، زرده که کلاه داره. و ویلیام روکش بارونی کالسکه‌اش را لازم داره.

branches.suggestion: I'll put the rain cover on.
Where is the rain cover?

cultureNote.en: British "buggy" or "pushchair"; American "stroller".
cultureNote.fa: buggy/stroller.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: It's under the buggy, in the basket. Have you got an umbrella?

translations.fa: زیر کالسکه، تو سبده. چتر داری؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, a big one.
No. Can I borrow one?
