n2.text: Not that one. That's for the 55. Your stop is opposite the church.

translations.fa: اون نه. اون مال ۵۵ـه. ایستگاه تو روبروی کلیساست.

branches.suggestion: Opposite the church. OK.
Which church?

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: St John's. The big one with the clock. Behind it, there's a park.

translations.fa: سنت جان. بزرگه که ساعت داره. پشتش یه پارکه.

branches.suggestion: I know it! Behind the church is the park.
Is it far from here?

match: the park is in behind church
recasts.echo: Behind the church? Spot on.
recasts.better: The park is behind the church.

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: Two minutes. Look for the stop letter. It's stop M.

translations.fa: دو دقیقه. دنبال حرف ایستگاه بگرد. ایستگاه M ـه.

branches.suggestion: What's a stop letter?
M. That's easy to remember.

cultureNote.en: Many London bus stops have a letter on top, like "M", to help you find the right one.
cultureNote.fa: ایستگاه‌های لندن حرف دارند.

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: There are lots of stops near each other. The letter helps. Which bus do you need?

translations.fa: کلی ایستگاه نزدیک هم هست. حرفه کمک می‌کنه. کدوم اتوبوس لازمته؟

branches.suggestion: The 38. Your bus!
I don't know. Can you tell me?

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: My bus! The 38. Get off at the Angel. Seven stops.

translations.fa: اتوبوس خودم! ۳۸. ایستگاه انجل پیاده شو. هفت ایستگاه.

branches.suggestion: Seven stops. Will you be driving?
How do I know when to get off?
branches.suggestionFa: از کجا بفهمم کی پیاده شم؟

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: There's a screen inside. It shows the next stop. And a voice says it.

translations.fa: داخلش یه صفحه هست. ایستگاه بعدی را نشون میده. یه صدا هم میگه.

branches.suggestion: Then I press the red button.
branches.suggestionFa: بعد دکمهٔ قرمز را فشار میدم.

branches.suggestion: That's helpful for me.

n8.speaker: tom
n8.text: Exactly! And I'm on the early shift tomorrow. If you see me, wave. I'll do my best announcer voice!

translations.fa: دقیقاً! و فردا شیفت صبحم. اگه منو دیدی دست تکون بده. بهترین صدای گوینده‌م را درمیارم!

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: I'm on my break. Let's get a coffee. Do you know Mario's café?

translations.fa: تو استراحتم. بیا یه قهوه بخوریم. کافه ماریو را بلدی؟

branches.suggestion: No. Where is it?
Is it near the bus station?

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: It's next to the bank. On the high street.

translations.fa: کنار بانکه. تو خیابون اصلی.

branches.suggestion: Next to the bank. I see it!
Which bank?

cultureNote.en: British "high street", American "main street".
cultureNote.fa: high street/main street.

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: The one where I go. Between the bank and the chemist. Little blue sign.

translations.fa: همونی که من میرم. بین بانک و داروخونه. یه تابلوی کوچیک آبی.

branches.suggestion: Between the bank and the chemist.
Is the chemist the pharmacy?

cultureNote.en: British "chemist's", American "drugstore". "Pharmacy" is used in both.
cultureNote.fa: chemist/drugstore.

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: Yes, same thing. And the bakery is on the corner, opposite.

translations.fa: آره، یه چیزه. و نونوایی سر نبش، روبروشه.

branches.suggestion: On the corner. Got it.
Shall we get a cake there too?

recasts.echo: On the corner? That's right.
recasts.better: The bakery is on the corner.

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: No cake! Leslie says I'm getting a belly. Look, there's Mario's! Under the blue sign.

translations.fa: کیک نه! لزلی میگه شکم آوردم. نگاه کن، کافه ماریو! زیر تابلوی آبی.

branches.suggestion: It's very small.
Is there a table inside?

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: Small but perfect. Sit by the window. Mario makes the best coffee in Hackney.

translations.fa: کوچیک ولی عالی. کنار پنجره بشین. ماریو بهترین قهوهٔ هکنی را درست می‌کنه.

branches.suggestion: Better than Callum's?
I'll have a cappuccino.

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: Shh! Don't tell Callum. He's Leslie's favourite. Two coffees, fifteen minutes, then back on the bus!

translations.fa: هیس! به کالوم نگو. محبوب لزلیه. دو تا قهوه، پونزده دقیقه، بعد برگشت به اتوبوس!

n1.speaker: doris
n1.text: Tom, dear, I need the health centre today. Just a check-up. Which stop is it?

translations.fa: تام عزیز، امروز باید برم درمانگاه. فقط یه چکاپ. کدوم ایستگاه؟

branches.suggestion: Tom's busy driving. Can I help?
branches.suggestionFa: تام سرش به رانندگی گرمه. می‌تونم کمک کنم؟

branches.suggestion: Is it the one on Essex Road?

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: Essex Road, Doris. Get off at the next-but-one stop. {you} will show you.

translations.fa: اسکس رود، دوریس. ایستگاه بعد از بعدی پیاده شو. {you} نشونت میده.

branches.suggestion: First, we get off the bus.
What's "next-but-one"?

n3.speaker: doris
n3.text: It means the second stop. Thank you, dear. Then which way?

translations.fa: یعنی ایستگاه دوم. ممنون عزیزم. بعد از کدوم طرف؟

branches.suggestion: Then go straight on.
Then turn right at the lights.

n4.speaker: doris
n4.text: Right at the lights. After that?

translations.fa: سر چراغ راست. بعد از اون؟

branches.suggestion: After that, it's on your left.
After that, walk past the school.
branches.suggestionFa: بعد از اون، از جلوی مدرسه رد بشید.

match: after that is in your left
recasts.echo: After that, it's on your left? Lovely.
recasts.better: After that, it's on your left.

n5.speaker: doris
n5.text: Past the school, then on my left. How many minutes?

translations.fa: از جلوی مدرسه، بعد سمت چپم. چند دقیقه؟

branches.suggestion: About ten minutes.
Not far. Five minutes.

n6.speaker: doris
n6.text: Can you tell me again? Slowly? My memory is like a sieve!

translations.fa: می‌شه دوباره بگی؟ آروم؟ حافظه‌م مثل آبکشه!

branches.suggestion: First, straight on. Then right at the lights.
branches.suggestionFa: اول، مستقیم. بعد سر چراغ راست.

branches.suggestion: After that, it's on your left.

cultureNote.en: "A memory like a sieve" is a British idiom for forgetting things easily.
cultureNote.fa: حافظه مثل آبکش.

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: Here's your stop, Doris! Mind the step. Good luck with the check-up!

translations.fa: ایستگاهت رسید دوریس! مواظب پله باش. چکاپت به خیر!

branches.suggestion: Bye, Doris!
Do you want me to come with you?

n8.speaker: doris
n8.text: No, no, I'm fine. Straight on, right, left. Thank you, my dears! See you on Thursday, Tom!

translations.fa: نه، نه، خوبم. مستقیم، راست، چپ. ممنون عزیزانم! پنجشنبه می‌بینمت تام!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Big news! William's learning to use the potty. No more nappies in the day!

translations.fa: خبر بزرگ! ویلیام داره یاد می‌گیره از لگن استفاده کنه. دیگه روزها پوشک نمی‌خواد!

branches.suggestion: Well done, William!
Is it difficult?

cultureNote.en: British "nappy", American "diaper".
cultureNote.fa: nappy/diaper.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: It's hard work! He needs to go every hour. And I have to remember to ask him!

translations.fa: کار سختیه! باید هر ساعت بره. و من باید یادم باشه ازش بپرسم!

branches.suggestion: Every hour? Wow.
I can help you remember.
branches.suggestionFa: من می‌تونم کمکت کنم یادت بمونه.

n3.speaker: william
n3.text: Look! I've got big boy pants!

translations.fa: ببین! شورت پسر بزرگ دارم!

branches.suggestion: Wow! They've got buses on them!
Very smart, William!

cultureNote.en: In the UK "pants" means underwear; in the US "pants" means trousers!
cultureNote.fa: pants در بریتانیا یعنی شورت.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: He loves them. Now, if he says "wee", we have to be quick! The potty's in the bathroom.

translations.fa: عاشقشونه. حالا اگه گفت «جیش»، باید سریع باشیم! لگن تو حمومه.

branches.suggestion: OK. I'll be quick.
Do we have to run?

recasts.echo: We have to be quick? Yes!

n5.speaker: william
n5.text: Wee! I need a wee!

translations.fa: جیش! جیش دارم!

branches.suggestion: Quick! Let's go!
Leslie! He needs a wee!

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Go, go, go! … Phew, he did it! Now we need to wash our hands.

translations.fa: برو، برو، برو! … آخیش، انجامش داد! حالا باید دستامون را بشوریم.

branches.suggestion: Hooray! Well done, William!
I'll get the soap.

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: He gets a sticker for his chart. Five stickers and he gets a toy bus. You're a natural, {you}!

translations.fa: یه برچسب برای جدولش می‌گیره. پنج برچسب، یه اتوبوس اسباب‌بازی. تو ذاتاً بلدی {you}!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: William said something so funny at breakfast. He called the pasta "pasghetti"!

translations.fa: ویلیام سر صبحونه یه چیز خیلی بامزه گفت. به پاستا گفت «پسگتی»!

branches.suggestion: Ha! I was there. He said it!
What did Tom say?

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Tom laughed for ten minutes. And yesterday William said the bus was "a big red bunny"!

translations.fa: تام ده دقیقه خندید. و دیروز ویلیام گفت اتوبوس «یه خرگوش قرمز بزرگ» بود!

branches.suggestion: A bunny? Not a bus?
He was being silly.

n3.speaker: william
n3.text: It was a bunny bus! Hop hop!

translations.fa: یه اتوبوس خرگوشی بود! هاپ هاپ!

branches.suggestion: A bunny bus! Brilliant!
Do bunny buses hop?

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Last week he said "aminal" for animal. Nicola said it too when she was three!

translations.fa: هفتهٔ پیش به حیوان گفت «اَمینال». نیکولا هم وقتی سه سالش بود همینو می‌گفت!

branches.suggestion: That's so sweet!
Was Ryan funny too?

recasts.echo: He said "aminal"? So sweet!

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Ryan called his shoes "shoo-shoos" until he was four! Don't tell him I told you. What about you, {you}?

translations.fa: رایان تا چهار سالگی به کفشاش می‌گفت «شوشو»! بهش نگی بهت گفتم. تو چی {you}؟

branches.suggestion: I don't know. I was very small!
My mum says I called water "ab-ab".

cultureNote.en: Many British parents keep a "baby book" or notes of their children's funny words.
cultureNote.fa: بسیاری از والدین کلمه‌های بامزهٔ بچه‌ها را یادداشت می‌کنند.

n6.speaker: william
n6.text: Pasghetti! Aminal! Bunny bus!

translations.fa: پسگتی! اَمینال! اتوبوس خرگوشی!

branches.suggestion: Ha! He knows they're funny!
You're a funny boy, William!

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: He does! Right, let's write them in his book before he says them properly.

translations.fa: می‌دونه! خب، بیا قبل از اینکه درست بگه، تو دفترش بنویسیمشون.

n1.speaker: william
n1.text: I'm hungry! I want a snack!

translations.fa: گرسنمه! خوراکی می‌خوام!

branches.suggestion: Do you want some fruit?
Leslie, he's hungry!

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Can you get him a snack? There are grapes in the fridge. Cut them in half, please.

translations.fa: می‌تونی براش خوراکی بیاری؟ تو یخچال انگور هست. لطفاً نصفشون کن.

branches.suggestion: In half? Why?
OK. And a drink?

cultureNote.en: UK parents cut grapes in half (or quarters) for small children, so they don't choke.
cultureNote.fa: والدین انگور را برای بچه‌های کوچک نصف می‌کنند.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Whole grapes aren't safe for little ones. And yes — milk in his blue cup, please.

translations.fa: انگور درسته برای بچه‌های کوچیک امن نیست. و آره — لطفاً شیر تو لیوان آبیش.

branches.suggestion: Here's the blue cup.
Not the red cup?

n4.speaker: william
n4.text: Not red! Blue! I want blue!

translations.fa: قرمز نه! آبی! آبی می‌خوام!

branches.suggestion: Here's your blue cup, William.
Do you want to hold it?

recasts.echo: Here's your cup? He's happy!

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Everything has to be blue this week. Last week it was green! Do you want to sit with him?

translations.fa: این هفته همه چی باید آبی باشه. هفتهٔ پیش سبز بود! می‌خوای کنارش بشینی؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I'd love to.
Do you want a grape too?

n6.speaker: william
n6.text: Mmm. All gone! More grapes, please!

translations.fa: ممم. تموم شد! انگور بیشتر، لطفاً!

branches.suggestion: All gone! Well done!
Wow, that was fast.

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: No more now, or he won't eat his tea. Can you give him a cracker instead?

translations.fa: دیگه بسه، وگرنه شامش را نمی‌خوره. می‌تونی به‌جاش یه بیسکویت شور بهش بدی؟

branches.suggestion: Here's a cracker, William.
Do you want a cracker?

cultureNote.en: For many British families, "tea" is the evening meal, especially for children.
cultureNote.fa: برای خیلی از خانواده‌ها tea یعنی شام.

n8.speaker: william
n8.text: Yes, please! Thank you! I love crackers!

translations.fa: آره، لطفاً! ممنون! عاشق کراکرم!

branches.suggestion: Good manners, William!
You're welcome!

n9.speaker: leslie
n9.text: Ha! "Please" and "thank you"! Nana taught him that. Thank you, {you}!

translations.fa: ها! «لطفاً» و «ممنون»! نانا یادش داده. ممنون {you}!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Shh! William's having his nap. Finally! Come in, but be very quiet.

translations.fa: هیس! ویلیام داره چرت بعدازظهرش را می‌زنه. بالاخره! بیا تو، ولی خیلی ساکت.

branches.suggestion: Sorry. I'll whisper.
Is he sleeping on the sofa?

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: No, he's sleeping in his bed. The monitor is on. Look, you can see him.

translations.fa: نه، تو تختش خوابیده. دوربین روشنه. ببین، می‌تونی ببینیش.

branches.suggestion: He's smiling in his sleep.
What's he holding?

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: His toy bus! Of course. Would you like a cup of tea? I'm making one.

translations.fa: اتوبوس اسباب‌بازیش! معلومه. چای می‌خوری؟ دارم درست می‌کنم.

branches.suggestion: Yes, please. Quietly!
I'm making it. You rest.
branches.suggestionFa: من درست می‌کنم. تو استراحت کن.

recasts.echo: You're making it? Thank you!

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Oh, thank you! I'm so tired. What's Ryan doing upstairs? It's very loud.

translations.fa: آه، ممنون! خیلی خسته‌م. رایان بالا چی کار می‌کنه؟ خیلی سروصدا داره.

branches.suggestion: I think he's playing a game.
He's listening to music.

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Can you text him? Tell him William is sleeping.

translations.fa: می‌تونی بهش پیام بدی؟ بگو ویلیام خوابه.

branches.suggestion: OK. I'm texting him now.
branches.suggestionFa: باشه. الان دارم بهش پیام میدم.

branches.suggestion: I'll go up and tell him.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Perfect. Oh no — the doorbell! Who's ringing the bell now?

translations.fa: عالی. وای نه — زنگ در! کی الان داره زنگ می‌زنه؟

branches.suggestion: I'll get it! Quickly!
It's the postman, I think.

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Phew. He's still sleeping. Next time, put a note on the door: "Little one napping! Please knock!"

translations.fa: آخیش. هنوز خوابه. دفعهٔ بعد، یه یادداشت بذار رو در: «بچه خوابه! لطفاً در بزنید!»

n1.speaker: mia
n1.text: Hello! I'm drawing a unicorn. Do you like drawing?

translations.fa: سلام! دارم یه تک‌شاخ می‌کشم. نقاشی دوست داری؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I like drawing.
Not really. I'm not good at it.

recasts.echo: You like drawing? Me too!

n2.speaker: mia
n2.text: Everybody's good at drawing! Look, my unicorn has a rainbow tail.

translations.fa: همه نقاشیشون خوبه! ببین، تک‌شاخ من دُم رنگین‌کمونی داره.

branches.suggestion: It's beautiful, Mia.
What colour is the horn?

n3.speaker: mia
n3.text: Gold! Nicola is drawing too. She's drawing Mr Buttons. What do you like doing?

translations.fa: طلایی! نیکولا هم داره نقاشی می‌کشه. داره آقای دکمه را می‌کشه. تو چی دوست داری؟

branches.suggestion: I like cooking.
I like reading and walking.
branches.suggestionFa: کتاب خوندن و پیاده‌روی دوست دارم.

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: {you} makes yummy rice! With crispy bits on the bottom!

translations.fa: {you} برنج خوشمزه درست می‌کنه! با تیکه‌های ترد ته‌ش!

branches.suggestion: That's called tahdig.
Thank you, Nicola!

cultureNote.en: Tahdig, the crispy rice at the bottom of the pot, is a favourite Persian dish.
cultureNote.fa: ته‌دیگ.

n5.speaker: mia
n5.text: Tahdig! Funny word. My hobby is ballet. I go every Saturday.

translations.fa: ته‌دیگ! کلمهٔ بامزه‌ای. سرگرمی من باله‌ست. هر شنبه میرم.

branches.suggestion: Do you like ballet?
Every Saturday? That's great.

n6.speaker: mia
n6.text: I love it! Can you draw something for me? Draw a cat!

translations.fa: عاشقشم! می‌تونی یه چیزی برام بکشی؟ یه گربه بکش!

branches.suggestion: OK. Here's a cat.
I'm drawing a cat, but it looks like a dog!
branches.suggestionFa: دارم گربه می‌کشم، ولی شبیه سگ شده!

n7.speaker: mia
n7.text: Ha ha! It IS a dog! Nicola, look at {you}'s dog-cat!

translations.fa: ها ها! واقعاً سگه! نیکولا، گربه‌سگ {you} را ببین!

branches.suggestion: It's a new animal!
I told you I'm not good at drawing!

n8.speaker: mia
n8.text: It's a "cog"! I love it. Can I keep it? I'll put it on my bedroom wall.

translations.fa: یه «گرسگه»! عاشقشم. می‌تونم نگهش دارم؟ می‌زنمش به دیوار اتاقم.

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: Listen! That's Ryan. He plays the guitar. He practises every day!

translations.fa: گوش کن! رایانه. گیتار می‌زنه. هر روز تمرین می‌کنه!

branches.suggestion: Is he good?
It sounds nice.

cultureNote.en: British "practise" (verb) / "practice" (noun); Americans write "practice" for both.
cultureNote.fa: practise/practice.

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: He's OK. Mummy says he's getting better. He plays loud songs.

translations.fa: خوبه. مامان میگه داره بهتر میشه. آهنگ‌های بلند می‌زنه.

branches.suggestion: Does he have lessons?
What songs does he play?

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: He has lessons at school on Tuesdays. Mia, do you play the piano?

translations.fa: سه‌شنبه‌ها تو مدرسه کلاس داره. میا، تو پیانو می‌زنی؟

branches.suggestion: Mia, do you play an instrument?
Nicola, do you play the guitar?

n4.speaker: mia
n4.text: No. I play the recorder at school. It goes squeak!

translations.fa: نه. تو مدرسه فلوت ریکوردر می‌زنم. صدای جیغ میده!

branches.suggestion: Ha! I played the recorder too.
What's a recorder?

cultureNote.en: Almost every British child learns the recorder at primary school!
cultureNote.fa: تقریباً همهٔ بچه‌ها ریکوردر یاد می‌گیرند.

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: It's a little pipe. You blow it. Does Ryan play the drums? No! Mummy says no drums!

translations.fa: یه لوله کوچیکه. فوتش می‌کنی. رایان درام می‌زنه؟ نه! مامان میگه درام نه!

branches.suggestion: Drums are very loud.
He doesn't play the drums. Good!

recasts.echo: He doesn't play the drums? Phew!

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: Do you play music, {you}?

translations.fa: تو موسیقی می‌زنی {you}؟

branches.suggestion: I play the setar a little.
No, but I like singing.
branches.suggestionFa: نه، ولی خوندن را دوست دارم.

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: What's a setar?

translations.fa: سه‌تار چیه؟

branches.suggestion: It's like a small guitar. From Iran.
branches.suggestionFa: شبیه یه گیتار کوچیکه. از ایران.

branches.suggestion: It has three strings. Well, four!
branches.suggestionFa: سه تا سیم داره. خب، چهار تا!

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Can you play it with Ryan? A band! Mia and me can dance. And Mr Buttons can sing!

translations.fa: می‌تونی با رایان بزنیش؟ یه گروه! من و میا می‌رقصیم. و آقای دکمه می‌خونه!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: It's sunny! Let's play football in the garden! Me and Mia against you!

translations.fa: آفتابیه! بیا تو حیاط فوتبال بازی کنیم! من و میا در برابر تو!

branches.suggestion: Two against one? That's not fair!
OK! Let's play!

cultureNote.en: British "garden", American "yard" (for the grass area by a house).
cultureNote.fa: garden/yard.

n2.speaker: mia
n2.text: You're a grown-up. You're bigger! The goal is between the two trees.

translations.fa: تو بزرگسالی. بزرگ‌تری! دروازه بین اون دو تا درخته.

branches.suggestion: And my goal?
Where's the ball?

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: Your goal is the shed! The ball is under the bush. Can you get it?

translations.fa: دروازه‌ت انباریه! توپ زیر بوته‌ست. می‌تونی بیاریش؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, here it is.
It's very muddy!

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: Kick off! Mia, pass to me! Pass! Pass!

translations.fa: شروع! میا، پاس بده به من! پاس! پاس!

branches.suggestion: I'm coming to get it!
Good pass, Mia!

n5.speaker: mia
n5.text: GOAL! Nicola scored! One–nil to us!

translations.fa: گل! نیکولا گل زد! یک صفر به نفع ما!

branches.suggestion: Well done, Nicola!
One–nil? I'm losing!

cultureNote.en: In football scores, British people say "nil" for zero: "two–nil".
cultureNote.fa: nil یعنی صفر.

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: Now it's your turn to kick. Can you score?

translations.fa: حالا نوبت توئه شوت بزنی. می‌تونی گل بزنی؟

branches.suggestion: I'm going to kick it hard!
Can I kick it gently? You're little!
branches.suggestionFa: می‌تونم آروم شوت بزنم؟ شما کوچیکید!

recasts.echo: You're going to kick it? Go on!

n7.speaker: mia
n7.text: Oh no! It went over the fence. Into Mrs Khan's garden!

translations.fa: ای وای! از رو حصار رفت. تو حیاط خانم خان!

branches.suggestion: Oops! Sorry!
Let's go and ask Mrs Khan.

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: You go! You kicked it! Say "Sorry, Mrs Khan, can we have our ball back, please?"

translations.fa: تو برو! تو شوتش کردی! بگو «ببخشید خانم خان، می‌شه توپمون را پس بدید، لطفاً؟»

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Shh, look. Maggie is reading to the girls. She does it every Friday.

translations.fa: هیس، ببین. مگی داره برای دخترها کتاب می‌خونه. هر جمعه این کار را می‌کنه.

branches.suggestion: That's lovely.
What book is it?

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: "The Gruffalo". The girls always choose that one! They know every word.

translations.fa: «گروفالو». دخترها همیشه همونو انتخاب می‌کنن! همهٔ کلمه‌هاش را بلدن.

branches.suggestion: Do they always choose it?
What's a Gruffalo?

cultureNote.en: "The Gruffalo" by Julia Donaldson is one of the best-loved British children's books.
cultureNote.fa: گروفالو کتاب محبوب کودکان.

n3.speaker: weda
n3.text: And the big, hairy monster opened his mouth and said… ROAR!

translations.fa: و هیولای بزرگ و پشمالو دهنش را باز کرد و گفت… غرررش!

branches.suggestion: Maggie reads very well!
The girls are scared!

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: She does the voices too. Do you read a lot, {you}?

translations.fa: صداها را هم درمیاره. تو زیاد کتاب می‌خونی {you}؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I usually read at night.
Sometimes. Not in English!

recasts.echo: You always read at night? Lovely.

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Try children's books! They're easy English. Maggie borrows them from the library.

translations.fa: کتاب بچه‌ها را امتحان کن! انگلیسی آسونی دارن. مگی از کتابخونه قرض می‌گیرتشون.

branches.suggestion: That's a good idea.
Is the library free?

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Yes, it's free! You just need a library card. Maggie never pays.

translations.fa: آره، مجانیه! فقط کارت کتابخونه لازمه. مگی هیچ‌وقت پول نمیده.

branches.suggestion: I never go to the library. I should!
branches.suggestionFa: من هیچ‌وقت کتابخونه نمیرم. باید برم!

branches.suggestion: Can Maggie show me?

cultureNote.en: UK public libraries are free to join and lend books, e-books and audiobooks.
cultureNote.fa: کتابخانه‌های عمومی رایگان.

n7.speaker: weda
n7.text: Of course, dear! Come with me on Tuesday. Mr Bennett is very helpful. Now — the end!

translations.fa: البته عزیزم! سه‌شنبه با من بیا. آقای بنت خیلی کمک می‌کنه. حالا — پایان!

branches.suggestion: Again! Again!
Thank you, Maggie.

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Ha! Now you sound like Nicola. "Again!" is her favourite word. Maggie, one more time?

translations.fa: ها! حالا مثل نیکولا حرف می‌زنی. «دوباره!» کلمهٔ محبوبشه. مگی، یه بار دیگه؟

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Look at that! It's raining again. Third day this week! Typical British summer!

translations.fa: اینو ببین! باز داره بارون میاد. سومین روز این هفته! تابستون معمولی بریتانیایی!

branches.suggestion: Is it always like this?
It's raining a lot!

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: Not always. Sometimes it's sunny for a whole afternoon! Ha! What's the weather like in Tehran?

translations.fa: نه همیشه. گاهی یه بعدازظهر کامل آفتابیه! ها! هوای تهران چطوره؟

branches.suggestion: It's hot and dry in summer.
It snows in winter.

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: Hot and dry! Lucky you. Here it's grey and wet. Is it going to stop? Let me check my phone.

translations.fa: گرم و خشک! خوش به حالت. اینجا خاکستری و خیسه. بند میاد؟ بذار با گوشیم ببینم.

branches.suggestion: What does the forecast say?
I think it's going to rain all day.
branches.suggestionFa: فکر کنم کل روز بارون میاد.

recasts.echo: It's going to rain all day? Probably!
recasts.better: It's going to rain all day.

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: It says "heavy showers". That means lots of rain, then a bit of sun, then more rain.

translations.fa: میگه «رگبار شدید». یعنی کلی بارون، بعد یه کم آفتاب، بعد بارون بیشتر.

branches.suggestion: Showers? Like in the bathroom?
British weather changes a lot.

cultureNote.en: "Showers" are short periods of rain. British people talk about the weather all the time — it's a safe small-talk topic.
cultureNote.fa: showers یعنی رگبار کوتاه.

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: Ha! Yes, a shower from the sky! I'm driving all day. The bus gets so wet and steamy.

translations.fa: ها! آره، دوش از آسمون! من کل روز رانندگی می‌کنم. اتوبوس خیلی خیس و بخار گرفته میشه.

branches.suggestion: Drive carefully, Tom.
Do more people take the bus when it rains?
branches.suggestionFa: وقتی بارون میاد آدم‌های بیشتری سوار اتوبوس میشن؟

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: Loads more! Everyone's dripping. And they all say "Lovely weather!" That's British humour.

translations.fa: خیلی بیشتر! همه آب ازشون می‌چکه. و همه میگن «چه هوای خوبی!» این شوخ‌طبعی بریتانیاییه.

branches.suggestion: "Lovely weather!" But it isn't!
So it's a joke?

cultureNote.en: British "humour", American "humor". Saying the opposite as a joke is very British.
cultureNote.fa: humour/humor.

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: Exactly! Try it. Say it to Leslie when she comes in. Watch her face!

translations.fa: دقیقاً! امتحانش کن. وقتی لزلی اومد تو بهش بگو. صورتش را ببین!

branches.suggestion: "Lovely weather, Leslie!"
She's going to laugh.

n8.speaker: tom
n8.text: Perfect! You're more British every day. Right, I'm off. Where's my umbrella? Oh no, Ryan's got it again!

translations.fa: عالی! هر روز بریتانیایی‌تر میشی. خب، من رفتم. چترم کو؟ وای نه، باز رایان برداشته!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: The hallway's full of wet things! Whose umbrella is this? The pink one.

translations.fa: راهرو پر از وسایل خیسه! این چتر مال کیه؟ صورتیه.

branches.suggestion: I think it's Nicola's.
It isn't mine.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Yes, it's Nicola's. And these wellies? The big green ones. Are they yours?

translations.fa: آره، مال نیکولاست. و این چکمه‌ها؟ سبزهای بزرگ. مال توئه؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, they're mine.
No. I think they're Ryan's.

cultureNote.en: "Wellies" (wellington boots) are rubber rain boots — named after the Duke of Wellington.
cultureNote.fa: wellies چکمهٔ لاستیکی.

recasts.echo: They're yours? Great.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Ryan's are muddy. These are clean. Where are your wellies, then?

translations.fa: مال رایان گلیه. اینا تمیزن. پس چکمه‌های تو کجان؟

branches.suggestion: I haven't got wellies.
Mine are at home, next door.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: No wellies? In London? You need some! Ah, these are George's.

translations.fa: چکمه نداری؟ تو لندن؟ لازم داری! آه، اینا مال جورجه.

branches.suggestion: Does George wear them?
Can I borrow them?

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Not anymore. He doesn't go out in the rain now, with his heart. Borrow them!

translations.fa: دیگه نه. با این قلبش الان زیر بارون نمیره بیرون. قرضشون بگیر!

branches.suggestion: Thank you. Are they my size?
I'll ask George first.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Try them on. And whose coat is this on the floor? It's soaking!

translations.fa: امتحانشون کن. و این کت رو زمین مال کیه؟ خیس آبه!

branches.suggestion: That's Tom's coat.
It's mine! Sorry!

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Hang it on the hook, please! Everyone, wet things on the hooks, boots on the mat!

translations.fa: لطفاً آویزونش کن رو قلاب! همه، وسایل خیس رو قلاب، چکمه‌ها رو پادری!

branches.suggestion: OK, boss!
Where's the mat?

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: By the door. Thank you! Honestly, this hallway is like a swimming pool. I need a coffee.

translations.fa: کنار در. ممنون! راستی این راهرو شبیه استخر شده. یه قهوه لازم دارم.

n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: It's still raining. I'm bored. Why don't we watch a film?

translations.fa: هنوز داره بارون میاد. حوصله‌م سر رفته. چرا فیلم نبینیم؟

branches.suggestion: Good idea. Which film?
How about a board game?

cultureNote.en: British "film", American "movie". Both are understood.
cultureNote.fa: film/movie.

n2.speaker: ryan
n2.text: Board games? Nicola cheats at everything! A film is better. How about an action film?

translations.fa: بازی رومیزی؟ نیکولا تو همه چی تقلب می‌کنه! فیلم بهتره. یه فیلم اکشن چطوره؟

branches.suggestion: I like action films.
Nicola's here. Something for kids?
branches.suggestionFa: نیکولا اینجاست. یه چیزی برای بچه‌ها؟

n3.speaker: ryan
n3.text: Ugh, you're right. Nicola wants Frozen. Again. Fiftieth time!

translations.fa: اوف، راست میگی. نیکولا فروزن می‌خواد. دوباره. پنجاهمین بار!

branches.suggestion: Why don't we watch Paddington?
How about a cartoon?

recasts.echo: How about watching Paddington? Yes!

n4.speaker: ryan
n4.text: Paddington! Yes. Everyone likes Paddington. Even Dad cries at the end.

translations.fa: پدینگتون! آره. همه پدینگتون دوست دارن. حتی بابا آخرش گریه می‌کنه.

branches.suggestion: Tom cries? Really?
I love that bear.

cultureNote.en: Paddington Bear is a much-loved British character who loves marmalade sandwiches.
cultureNote.fa: پدینگتون و ساندویچ مارمالاد.

n5.speaker: ryan
n5.text: Every time! Shall we make popcorn? Sweet or salty?

translations.fa: هر بار! پاپ‌کورن درست کنیم؟ شیرین یا شور؟

branches.suggestion: Salty, please.
Why don't we make both?
branches.suggestionFa: چرا هر دو را درست نکنیم؟

n6.speaker: ryan
n6.text: Both! You're a genius. And let's get the duvet from upstairs. Duvet day!

translations.fa: هر دو! نابغه‌ای. و بیا لحاف را از بالا بیاریم. روز لحاف!

branches.suggestion: What's a duvet day?
I'll get the cushions too.

cultureNote.en: A "duvet day" is a lazy day at home, cosy under a duvet.
cultureNote.fa: روز تنبلی زیر لحاف.

n7.speaker: ryan
n7.text: Lazy day on the sofa, under a duvet. Best thing about rain! Nicola! Film time!

translations.fa: روز تنبلی رو مبل، زیر لحاف. بهترین چیز بارون! نیکولا! وقت فیلمه!

branches.suggestion: Turn off the lights!
Has everyone got popcorn?

n8.speaker: ryan
n8.text: Lights off, popcorn ready, phones away. Wait — Mum said phones away? Fine. Press play!

translations.fa: چراغ‌ها خاموش، پاپ‌کورن آماده، گوشی‌ها کنار. صبر کن — مامان گفت گوشی‌ها کنار؟ باشه. پلی را بزن!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: The rain has stopped! Come to the front door, quick! Look at the sky!

translations.fa: بارون بند اومد! سریع بیا دم در! آسمون را ببین!

branches.suggestion: Wow! A rainbow!
What a beautiful sky!

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: A RAINBOW! How many colours are there, Mummy?

translations.fa: رنگین‌کمون! چند تا رنگ داره مامان؟

branches.suggestion: There are seven colours.
Let's count them!

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Seven! Red, orange, yellow, green, blue… Can you say the rest, {you}?

translations.fa: هفت تا! قرمز، نارنجی، زرد، سبز، آبی… می‌تونی بقیه را بگی {you}؟

branches.suggestion: Indigo and violet.
Purple! And… I don't know.

cultureNote.en: British children learn "Richard Of York Gave Battle In Vain" to remember the rainbow colours.
cultureNote.fa: جملهٔ یادآور رنگ‌ها.

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: How pretty! Is there gold at the end of the rainbow?

translations.fa: چه خوشگله! ته رنگین‌کمون طلا هست؟

branches.suggestion: That's a story from Ireland.
Let's go and look!

cultureNote.en: In Irish stories, a leprechaun hides a pot of gold at the end of the rainbow.
cultureNote.fa: دیگ طلا در افسانهٔ ایرلندی.

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Ha! We'll never find the end. It moves when you move. What a shame!

translations.fa: ها! هیچ‌وقت تهش را پیدا نمی‌کنیم. وقتی حرکت می‌کنی، حرکت می‌کنه. حیف!

branches.suggestion: What a shame!
How strange!

recasts.echo: What a shame? Yes, it is.

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: Can I take a photo for Daddy? He's on the bus!

translations.fa: می‌تونم برای بابا عکس بگیرم؟ تو اتوبوسه!

branches.suggestion: Here's my phone.
Hold it still. Click!

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: What a lovely photo! Send it to Daddy. He'll love it. Oh — it's raining again!

translations.fa: چه عکس قشنگی! بفرستش برای بابا. عاشقش میشه. آه — باز داره بارون میاد!

branches.suggestion: Typical!
Quick, inside!

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: "Typical!" That's what British people say. Inside, everyone! Wellies off!

translations.fa: «معمولیه!» این چیزیه که بریتانیایی‌ها میگن. همه بیاید تو! چکمه‌ها را دربیارید!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: It's Daddy's birthday tomorrow! I'm making him a card. It's a secret!

translations.fa: فردا تولد باباست! دارم براش کارت درست می‌کنم. رازه!

branches.suggestion: I won't tell him.
What a nice idea!

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: I'm drawing a bus on the front. Daddy's bus! Can you help me with the words?

translations.fa: دارم رو جلوش یه اتوبوس می‌کشم. اتوبوس بابا! تو کلمه‌ها کمکم می‌کنی؟

branches.suggestion: Of course. What do you want to say?
Start with "To Daddy".

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: "To Daddy". Then "Happy Birthday". How do you spell "birthday"?

translations.fa: «به بابا». بعد «تولدت مبارک». «برث‌دی» را چطوری می‌نویسن؟

branches.suggestion: B-I-R-T-H-D-A-Y.
Birth… day. Two small words!
branches.suggestionFa: برث… دی. دو تا کلمهٔ کوچیک!

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: Done! Then what? Mummy writes "Love from" at the end.

translations.fa: تموم شد! بعد چی؟ مامان آخرش می‌نویسه «با عشق از طرف».

branches.suggestion: Write "Love from Nicola".
Add some kisses. X X X.
branches.suggestionFa: چندتا بوس اضافه کن. X X X.

cultureNote.en: In British cards and texts, "x" means a kiss. People often sign "Love from… xx".
cultureNote.fa: x یعنی بوسه.

recasts.echo: "Love from Nicola"? Perfect!

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: X X X X X! Lots of kisses! Should I write a joke? Daddy loves jokes.

translations.fa: X X X X X! کلی بوس! یه جوک بنویسم؟ بابا عاشق جوکه.

branches.suggestion: Yes! What joke?
His jokes are terrible!

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: "What's a bus driver's favourite food? Bus-ghetti!" I made it up!

translations.fa: «غذای محبوب راننده اتوبوس چیه؟ باس-گتی!» خودم ساختمش!

branches.suggestion: Ha! Very funny.
That's as bad as Daddy's jokes!

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: I KNOW! He'll love it! Can you write your name too? It's from both of us.

translations.fa: می‌دونم! عاشقش میشه! اسم خودت را هم می‌نویسی؟ از طرف هر دومونه.

branches.suggestion: OK. "Love from {you}."
Here's my name, under yours.

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Now the envelope. I'm hiding it under my bed. Shh! Don't tell Daddy. Pinky promise!

translations.fa: حالا پاکت. زیر تختم قایمش می‌کنم. هیس! به بابا نگو. قول انگشت کوچیکه!

n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: Help! I bought Dad a present, but I can't wrap. It looks awful.

translations.fa: کمک! برای بابا کادو خریدم، ولی بلد نیستم کادو کنم. افتضاح شده.

branches.suggestion: What did you buy him?
Let me see.

n2.speaker: ryan
n2.text: A mug. It says "World's Best Bus Driver". Cheesy, I know.

translations.fa: یه ماگ. روش نوشته «بهترین راننده اتوبوس دنیا». می‌دونم، لوسه.

branches.suggestion: He's going to love it.
Cheesy? What does that mean?

cultureNote.en: "Cheesy" means too sweet or silly in a slightly embarrassing way.
cultureNote.fa: cheesy یعنی لوس.

n3.speaker: ryan
n3.text: OK, first cut the paper. Not too small. Where are the scissors?

translations.fa: باشه، اول کاغذ را ببر. خیلی کوچیک نه. قیچی کجاست؟

branches.suggestion: Here are the scissors.
Put the mug in a box first.
branches.suggestionFa: اول ماگ را بذار تو جعبه.

n4.speaker: ryan
n4.text: A box! Genius. It's easier with a box. Now what?

translations.fa: جعبه! نابغه. با جعبه آسون‌تره. حالا چی؟

branches.suggestion: Fold the paper over the box.
branches.suggestionFa: کاغذ را رو جعبه تا کن.

branches.suggestion: Hold it, and I'll stick it.

recasts.echo: Fold it over the box? OK!
recasts.better: Fold the paper over the box.
recasts.betterFa: کاغذ را رو جعبه تا کن.

n5.speaker: ryan
n5.text: Pass the Sellotape. Ugh, it's stuck to my fingers!

translations.fa: چسب را بده. اوف، به انگشتام چسبید!

branches.suggestion: Ha! Let me do it.
Cut a small piece first.

cultureNote.en: British "Sellotape", American "Scotch tape".
cultureNote.fa: Sellotape/Scotch tape.

n6.speaker: ryan
n6.text: Better. Now the ends. Fold them like triangles. Is that right?

translations.fa: بهتر شد. حالا دو طرفش. مثل مثلث تاشون کن. درسته؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, perfect!
Fold it again. It's a bit messy.
branches.suggestionFa: دوباره تاش کن. یه کم نامرتبه.

n7.speaker: ryan
n7.text: Nice! Now a bow on top. And a gift tag. What do I write?

translations.fa: خوبه! حالا یه پاپیون روش. و یه برچسب کادو. چی بنویسم؟

branches.suggestion: "Happy birthday, Dad. From Ryan."
Write "Love from Ryan".

n8.speaker: ryan
n8.text: "Love"? Too soppy! Just "From Ryan". OK, fine… "Love from Ryan". Don't tell my mates!

translations.fa: «عشق»؟ زیادی احساساتیه! فقط «از طرف رایان». باشه، خب… «با عشق، رایان». به دوستام نگو!

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Wow! Is this all for me? A cake? Presents? I'm only a humble bus driver!

translations.fa: وای! همه‌ش برای منه؟ کیک؟ کادو؟ من فقط یه رانندهٔ اتوبوس ساده‌ام!

branches.suggestion: Happy birthday, Tom!
Surprise!

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Happy birthday, love! Everyone, let's sing! Happy birthday to you…

translations.fa: تولدت مبارک عزیزم! همه، بیاید بخونیم! تولدت مبارک…

branches.suggestion: Happy birthday, dear Tom…
Happy birthday to you!

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: Blow out the candles, Daddy! Make a wish! But don't say it!

translations.fa: شمع‌ها را فوت کن بابا! آرزو کن! ولی نگو!

branches.suggestion: Make a wish, Tom!
Why can't he say it?

cultureNote.en: In Britain, if you say your birthday wish out loud, people say it won't come true.
cultureNote.fa: آرزو را بلند نگو.

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: Because then it won't come true! OK… one big breath… Phwoooo!

translations.fa: چون اون وقت برآورده نمیشه! باشه… یه نفس عمیق… پوووف!

branches.suggestion: Well done! All of them!
One is still burning!

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: That's a trick candle! It comes back! Ha! Who did this? Ryan!

translations.fa: این شمع کلکیه! دوباره روشن میشه! ها! کی این کار را کرد؟ رایان!

branches.suggestion: Ha ha! Good one, Ryan.
Try again, Tom!

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: Phew, got it! Right, presents. A card! "What's a bus driver's favourite food? Bus-ghetti!" Ha! Who wrote this?

translations.fa: آخیش، خاموش شد! خب، کادوها. یه کارت! «غذای محبوب راننده اتوبوس چیه؟ باس-گتی!» ها! کی اینو نوشته؟

branches.suggestion: Nicola did!
We both did.

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: It's the best joke I've ever heard! And a mug. "World's Best Bus Driver"! Thank you, Ryan.

translations.fa: بهترین جوکیه که تا حالا شنیدم! و یه ماگ. «بهترین راننده اتوبوس دنیا»! ممنون رایان.

branches.suggestion: Do you like it?
You can use it at work!
branches.suggestionFa: می‌تونی سر کار ازش استفاده کنی!

n8.speaker: tom
n8.text: Love it! Thank you for the cake, and my lovely family. And {you}, our best neighbour!

translations.fa: عاشقشم! ممنون بابت کیک، و خانوادهٔ نازنینم. و {you}، بهترین همسایه‌مون!

branches.suggestion: Thank you, Tom.
Let's eat the cake!

n9.speaker: tom
n9.text: Yes! Cake! Biggest piece for the birthday boy! Leslie, I'm cutting it. Where's the big knife?

translations.fa: آره! کیک! بزرگ‌ترین تیکه برای پسر تولد! لزلی، من می‌برمش. چاقوی بزرگه کو؟

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Right, Nicola. Tomorrow you're writing thank-you notes. For your birthday presents!

translations.fa: خب نیکولا. فردا یادداشت تشکر می‌نویسی. برای کادوهای تولدت!

branches.suggestion: What are thank-you notes?
That's very polite.

cultureNote.en: Many British families teach children to write short thank-you notes after birthdays and Christmas.
cultureNote.fa: نوشتن یادداشت تشکر.

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: Boring! Do I have to? Can {you} help me?

translations.fa: خسته‌کننده‌ست! مجبورم؟ {you} کمکم می‌کنه؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I'll help you.
It's fun. Let's do it together.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Thank you! First, Nana. She gave Nicola a book.

translations.fa: ممنون! اول، نانا. به نیکولا یه کتاب داد.

branches.suggestion: "Dear Nana, thank you for the book."
Which book was it?

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: The one about dinosaurs! Write "I love it. I read it every night."

translations.fa: همونی که دربارهٔ دایناسورهاست! بنویس «عاشقشم. هر شب می‌خونمش.»

branches.suggestion: Good! That's a nice thing to say.
Do you really read it every night?

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: Mummy reads it! Next, Mia. She gave me hair clips. And she came to my party.

translations.fa: مامان می‌خونه! بعدی، میا. بهم گیرهٔ مو داد. و اومد جشنم.

branches.suggestion: "Thank you for coming to my party."
"Thank you for the hair clips."

match: thanks to coming to my party
recasts.echo: "Thank you for coming"? Lovely!
recasts.better: Thank you for coming to my party.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Both! Lovely. Then draw a picture and sign it. How many more, Nicola?

translations.fa: هر دو! عالی. بعد یه نقاشی بکش و امضاش کن. چند تای دیگه مونده نیکولا؟

branches.suggestion: Let's count.
Only five more!

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Five?! My hand is tired! Can I just say "thank you" on the phone?

translations.fa: پنج تا؟! دستم خسته شده! می‌شه فقط تلفنی بگم «ممنون»؟

branches.suggestion: A note is better.
One a day. Five days!

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Great idea — one a day! And next year you can write one to {you} too. Thank you for helping!

translations.fa: فکر عالیه — روزی یکی! و سال بعد یکی هم برای {you} می‌نویسی. ممنون بابت کمک!

n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: Saturday cleaning day. Worst day of the week. Mum says I have to hoover.

translations.fa: شنبه روز نظافت. بدترین روز هفته. مامان میگه باید جاروبرقی بکشم.

branches.suggestion: I can help you.
What does "hoover" mean?

cultureNote.en: British people often say "hoover" (a brand name) for "vacuum".
cultureNote.fa: hoover = vacuum.

n2.speaker: ryan
n2.text: It means vacuum. Hoover is a brand. Can you move the chairs?

translations.fa: یعنی جاروبرقی. هوور یه مارکه. می‌تونی صندلی‌ها را جابه‌جا کنی؟

branches.suggestion: Sure. I'll move the chairs.
Where shall I put them?

n3.speaker: ryan
n3.text: On the table. Upside down. There are crumbs everywhere. William drops everything!

translations.fa: رو میز. برعکس. همه جا خرده‌ریزه. ویلیام همه چی را میندازه!

branches.suggestion: There's rice under his chair!
He's a messy eater.

n4.speaker: ryan
n4.text: Ugh. OK, I'm switching it on. It's really loud. Can you hear me?

translations.fa: اوف. باشه، روشنش می‌کنم. خیلی پرسروصداست. صدام را می‌شنوی؟

branches.suggestion: Sorry, what? I can't hear you!
Yes, but it's very loud.

n5.speaker: ryan
n5.text: WHAT? Oh, wait. It's stopped. Is it full?

translations.fa: چی؟ آه، صبر کن. خاموش شد. پر شده؟

branches.suggestion: I think the bag is full.
Check the plug.

recasts.echo: The bag's full? Probably.
recasts.better: I think the bag is full.

n6.speaker: ryan
n6.text: Not the bag. Nicola pulled the plug out! Nicola!

translations.fa: کیسه نیست. نیکولا دوشاخه را کشیده! نیکولا!

branches.suggestion: Ha! She's playing a trick.
I'll plug it back in.

n7.speaker: ryan
n7.text: Thanks. Right, nearly done. Can you do under the sofa? My arm's too big.

translations.fa: ممنون. خب، تقریباً تمومه. می‌تونی زیر مبل را بکشی؟ دستم خیلی بزرگه.

branches.suggestion: OK, I'll do under the sofa.
branches.suggestionFa: باشه، زیر مبل را من می‌کشم.

branches.suggestion: There's a sock under here!

n8.speaker: ryan
n8.text: My sock! I lost that in March. Cleaning day isn't that bad, I guess. Tea break?

translations.fa: جورابم! مارس گمش کردم. فکر کنم روز نظافت اون‌قدرا هم بد نیست. استراحت چای؟

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: Mummy gave me a duster! I'm dusting the shelves. Look, I'm a big helper!

translations.fa: مامان بهم دستمال گردگیری داد! دارم قفسه‌ها را گردگیری می‌کنم. ببین، کمک‌کار بزرگی‌ام!

branches.suggestion: You're a great helper!
Can I help you dust?

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: You do the high shelf. I can't reach. What's on the high shelf?

translations.fa: تو قفسهٔ بالایی را بکن. دستم نمی‌رسه. رو قفسهٔ بالایی چیه؟

branches.suggestion: There's a big jar on the shelf.
There are lots of cookbooks.

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: That's Daddy's biscuit jar! Is it full? Can I have one?

translations.fa: اون ظرف بیسکویت باباست! پره؟ می‌تونم یکی بخورم؟

branches.suggestion: Ask Mummy first.
After the cleaning, maybe.

cultureNote.en: British "biscuit", American "cookie" (and an American "biscuit" is like a scone).
cultureNote.fa: biscuit/cookie.

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: OK. Oh! What's behind the jar? Something shiny!

translations.fa: باشه. آه! پشت ظرف چیه؟ یه چیز براق!

branches.suggestion: It's a key. Behind the jar.
I think it's a coin.

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: A key! It's Nana's lost key! She looked everywhere!

translations.fa: کلید! کلید گم‌شدهٔ ناناست! همه جا را گشت!

branches.suggestion: Put it on the table for her.
Nana will be very happy.

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: Now the photos. There's one of me as a baby. In front of the clock!

translations.fa: حالا عکس‌ها. یکی از بچگی منه. جلوی ساعت!

branches.suggestion: You were so small!
Who's that next to you?

match: the photo is front of the clock
recasts.echo: In front of the clock? Yes!
recasts.better: The photo is in front of the clock.

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: That's Ryan! He was little too! Atchoo! The dust makes me sneeze!

translations.fa: اون رایانه! اونم کوچیک بود! هاپچه! گرد و خاک عطسه‌م میندازه!

branches.suggestion: Bless you!
Let's open the window.

cultureNote.en: When someone sneezes, British people say "Bless you!"
cultureNote.fa: Bless you پس از عطسه.

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: All done! The shelves are shiny. Can I have a biscuit NOW? I was very good!

translations.fa: همه‌ش تموم شد! قفسه‌ها براقن. الان می‌تونم بیسکویت بخورم؟ خیلی خوب بودم!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Thanks for helping, {you}. The kitchen's a mess. Can you put the shopping away?

translations.fa: ممنون که کمک می‌کنی {you}. آشپزخونه به هم ریخته‌ست. می‌تونی خریدها را بچینی؟

branches.suggestion: Yes. Where does the milk go?
Sure. Where do I start?

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Milk goes in the fridge. In the door, at the bottom.

translations.fa: شیر میره تو یخچال. تو در، پایین.

branches.suggestion: Got it. What about the eggs?
And the butter?

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Butter goes in the fridge too. Eggs go in the cupboard.

translations.fa: کره هم میره تو یخچال. تخم‌مرغ‌ها میرن تو کابینت.

branches.suggestion: In the cupboard? Not the fridge?
OK. Which cupboard?

cultureNote.en: In the UK, eggs are often kept in the cupboard, not the fridge. In America they must go in the fridge.
cultureNote.fa: تخم‌مرغ بیرون از یخچال.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: British eggs are fine in the cupboard! The one above the kettle. What's next?

translations.fa: تخم‌مرغ بریتانیایی تو کابینت خوبه! همونی که بالای کتریه. بعدی چیه؟

branches.suggestion: A big bag of rice.
Tins of tomatoes.

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Rice and tins go in the tall cupboard. The bottom shelf.

translations.fa: برنج و کنسروها میرن تو کابینت بلنده. قفسهٔ پایینی.

branches.suggestion: Where does the bread go?
They're very heavy!

recasts.echo: Where does the bread go? In the bread bin!

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: In the bread bin, next to the toaster. And the bananas go in the fruit bowl.

translations.fa: تو جانونی، کنار توستر. و موزها میرن تو کاسهٔ میوه.

branches.suggestion: Done! What's this?
Where does the washing powder go?

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Washing powder goes under the sink. Up high, actually. Away from William!

translations.fa: پودر لباسشویی میره زیر سینک. راستش، بالا. دور از دسترس ویلیام!

branches.suggestion: Good idea. Babies touch everything.
branches.suggestionFa: فکر خوبیه. بچه‌ها به همه چی دست می‌زنن.

branches.suggestion: I'll put it on the top shelf.

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Perfect. You know my kitchen better than Tom now! He puts the milk in the cupboard!

translations.fa: عالی. الان آشپزخونه‌م را از تام بهتر بلدی! اون شیر را تو کابینت می‌ذاره!

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Bin day tomorrow! The worst job. Can you help me sort the rubbish?

translations.fa: فردا روز سطل‌هاست! بدترین کار. کمکم می‌کنی زباله‌ها را جدا کنیم؟

branches.suggestion: Yes. Which bin is for what?
Sure. How many bins are there?

cultureNote.en: British "rubbish" and "bin", American "trash/garbage" and "trash can".
cultureNote.fa: rubbish/trash.

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: Four! Green, black, brown and the food caddy. Green is for recycling.

translations.fa: چهار تا! سبز، سیاه، قهوه‌ای و سطل غذا. سبز برای بازیافته.

branches.suggestion: What goes in recycling?
What's a food caddy?

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: Paper, cardboard, bottles and tins. Rinse them first! Is this yogurt pot clean?

translations.fa: کاغذ، مقوا، بطری و قوطی. اول آبشون بکش! این ظرف ماست تمیزه؟

branches.suggestion: No, it's dirty. I'll rinse it.
Yes, it's clean.

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: Good lad. Food goes in the little caddy. Banana skins, tea bags, eggshells.

translations.fa: آفرین. غذا میره تو سطل کوچیک. پوست موز، چای کیسه‌ای، پوست تخم‌مرغ.

branches.suggestion: Tea bags too?
Where does the black bin go?

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: Black is for everything else. Food wrappers, crisp packets. It's the smelly one!

translations.fa: سیاه برای بقیهٔ چیزهاست. کاغذ غذا، پاکت چیپس. همونی که بو میده!

branches.suggestion: Which bin is this for?
Where does the brown bin go?

recasts.echo: Which bin is this for? The black one!

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: The brown bin is for the garden. Grass and leaves. Now, which day do they come?

translations.fa: سطل قهوه‌ای برای باغچه‌ست. چمن و برگ. حالا، کدوم روز میان؟

branches.suggestion: Is it Tuesday?
Let's check the council website.
branches.suggestionFa: بیا سایت شهرداری را چک کنیم.

cultureNote.en: Each local council in the UK has its own bin rules and collection days — check their website.
cultureNote.fa: قوانین هر شهرداری فرق دارد.

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: Recycling this week. Black bin next week. They swap! I always forget.

translations.fa: این هفته بازیافت. هفتهٔ بعد سطل سیاه. نوبتی‌ان! من همیشه یادم میره.

branches.suggestion: Put a note on the fridge.
I'll text you on Monday night.

n8.speaker: tom
n8.text: You're a legend! Right, out they go. Mrs Khan already put hers out. She's never late!

translations.fa: اسطوره‌ای! خب، ببریمشون بیرون. خانم خان سطل‌هاش را گذاشته. هیچ‌وقت دیر نمی‌کنه!

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Leslie's having a lie-in. I'm making breakfast! Scrambled eggs. Want to help?

translations.fa: لزلی داره دیر بیدار میشه. من صبحونه درست می‌کنم! تخم‌مرغ همزده. کمک می‌کنی؟

branches.suggestion: Yes! What do I do first?
What's a lie-in?

newWords.fa: دیرتر بیدار شدن ؛ خوابیدن تا دیروقت

cultureNote.en: A "lie-in" is staying in bed late in the morning — a weekend treat for British parents!
cultureNote.fa: lie-in خواب صبح آخر هفته.

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: First, crack the eggs into the bowl. Eight eggs. Big family!

translations.fa: اول، تخم‌مرغ‌ها را تو کاسه بشکن. هشت تا. خانوادهٔ بزرگ!

branches.suggestion: Eight eggs! OK.
Oops, there's some shell in it.
branches.suggestionFa: اوه، یه کم پوسته افتاد توش.

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: No problem. Get it out with a spoon. Now whisk them. Fast!

translations.fa: مشکلی نیست. با قاشق درش بیار. حالا همشون بزن. سریع!

branches.suggestion: Like this?
What do I whisk with?

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: With a fork is fine. Add a bit of milk and some salt and pepper.

translations.fa: با چنگال هم خوبه. یه کم شیر و یه کم نمک و فلفل اضافه کن.

branches.suggestion: How much salt?
Just a pinch of salt?

recasts.echo: How much salt? Just a pinch!

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: A pinch. Now put butter in the pan. Medium heat, not high.

translations.fa: یه ذره. حالا کره را بذار تو تابه. حرارت متوسط، نه زیاد.

branches.suggestion: The butter's melting.
Now pour in the eggs?

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: Yes, pour them in. Stir slowly. Don't stop! Keep stirring!

translations.fa: آره، بریزشون. آروم هم بزن. وانسا! همینطور هم بزن!

branches.suggestion: I'm stirring. They're getting thick.
branches.suggestionFa: دارم هم می‌زنم. دارن سفت میشن.

branches.suggestion: When do I stop?

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: Take them off when they're still a bit soft. They keep cooking. Toast ready?

translations.fa: وقتی هنوز یه کم نرمن بردارشون. خودشون به پختن ادامه میدن. نون تست آماده‌ست؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, the toast is ready.
Shall I butter the toast?

n8.speaker: tom
n8.text: Perfect! Breakfast is served. Leslie, wake up! The chefs have been busy!

translations.fa: عالی! صبحونه حاضره. لزلی، بیدار شو! آشپزها حسابی کار کردن!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: Can I make toast? Mummy lets me press the button!

translations.fa: می‌تونم نون تست درست کنم؟ مامان میذاره دکمه را بزنم!

branches.suggestion: Yes, but be careful.
OK. How many slices?

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: Two for me and two for you! Put the bread in. Now I press… down!

translations.fa: دو تا برای من و دو تا برای تو! نون را بذار تو. حالا فشار میدم… پایین!

branches.suggestion: Well done!
Now we wait.

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: Pop! It's ready! Ooh, hot! Hot! Can you take it out?

translations.fa: پاپ! آماده‌ست! اوه، داغه! داغه! می‌تونی درش بیاری؟

branches.suggestion: Yes. Don't touch it.
Here's a plate.

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: What do you want on your toast? Jam? Butter? Marmite?

translations.fa: رو نون تستت چی می‌خوای؟ مربا؟ کره؟ مارمایت؟

branches.suggestion: I want butter and jam, please.
What's Marmite?

cultureNote.en: Marmite is a salty, dark spread made from yeast. British people say "you either love it or hate it".
cultureNote.fa: مارمایت را یا دوست دارید یا متنفرید.

match: i want the butter and the jam
recasts.echo: Butter and jam? Yummy!
recasts.better: I'd like butter and jam, please.

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: Marmite is brown and salty. Daddy loves it. I think it's yucky! Try some!

translations.fa: مارمایت قهوه‌ای و شوره. بابا عاشقشه. به نظر من حال‌به‌هم‌زنه! یه کم امتحان کن!

branches.suggestion: OK, just a little bit.
No, thank you!

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: Do you like it? Your face is funny!

translations.fa: دوستش داری؟ صورتت خنده‌دار شده!

branches.suggestion: It's very salty!
Actually, it's not bad.

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: You're like Daddy! Now I'm putting jam on mine. Lots of jam! Can I cut it into triangles?

translations.fa: مثل بابایی! حالا رو مال خودم مربا می‌زنم. کلی مربا! می‌تونم مثلثی ببرمش؟

branches.suggestion: Yes. Use the butter knife.
Squares or triangles?

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Triangles! Toast tastes better in triangles. Everybody knows that!

translations.fa: مثلث! نون تست مثلثی خوشمزه‌تره. همه اینو می‌دونن!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: I'm making leek and potato soup for tea. Could you help me? My hands are full!

translations.fa: دارم برای شام سوپ تره‌فرنگی و سیب‌زمینی درست می‌کنم. می‌شه کمکم کنی؟ دستام پره!

branches.suggestion: Of course. What's a leek?
Yes. What can I do?

cultureNote.en: Leek and potato soup is a classic, cheap British winter soup. The leek is also a symbol of Wales.
cultureNote.fa: سوپ تره‌فرنگی و نماد ولز.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: It's like a big green onion. Could you stir the butter and onions, please?

translations.fa: شبیه یه پیاز سبز بزرگه. لطفاً کره و پیازها را هم می‌زنی؟

branches.suggestion: Sure. Like this?
With the wooden spoon?

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Yes, the wooden spoon. Don't let them burn. Can you pass me the leeks?

translations.fa: آره، قاشق چوبی. نذار بسوزن. تره‌فرنگی‌ها را می‌دی؟

branches.suggestion: Here are the leeks.
Shall I chop them?

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Oh, yes please. Wash them first — they're often muddy inside. Could you peel the potatoes after?

translations.fa: آه، آره لطفاً. اول بشورشون — داخلشون معمولاً گلیه. بعدش سیب‌زمینی‌ها را پوست می‌کنی؟

branches.suggestion: No problem. Where's the peeler?
There's mud inside this one!

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Told you! The peeler's in the drawer. Can you boil some water too?

translations.fa: گفتم که! پوست‌کن تو کشوئه. یه کم آب هم جوش میاری؟

branches.suggestion: Can I use the kettle?
In the big pan?

recasts.echo: Can you use the kettle? Yes, it's faster!

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Yes, kettle first. It's faster. Then pour it in with a stock cube.

translations.fa: آره، اول کتری. سریع‌تره. بعد با یه عصارهٔ مرغ بریزش تو.

branches.suggestion: How long does it cook?
OK. Lid on?

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: About twenty minutes. Then we blend it. Could you set a timer?

translations.fa: حدود بیست دقیقه. بعد میکسش می‌کنیم. می‌شه یه تایمر بذاری؟

branches.suggestion: Timer set. Twenty minutes.
I'll set it on my phone.

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Lovely. Thank you! Could you stay for tea? There's plenty, with crusty bread. You did half the work!

translations.fa: عالی. ممنون! شام می‌مونی؟ زیاده، با نون برشته. نصف کار را تو کردی!

n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: It's Pancake Day! Best day of the year. Are you going to have pancakes with us?

translations.fa: روز پنکیکه! بهترین روز سال. با ما پنکیک می‌خوری؟

branches.suggestion: Yes! What's Pancake Day?
I'm going to eat ten!

cultureNote.en: Pancake Day (Shrove Tuesday) is the day before Lent. British pancakes are thin, like crêpes.
cultureNote.fa: سه‌شنبهٔ پنکیک قبل از روزهٔ مسیحی.

n2.speaker: ryan
n2.text: It's a Tuesday in February or March. Everyone eats pancakes! I'm going to flip them.

translations.fa: یه سه‌شنبه تو فوریه یا مارسه. همه پنکیک می‌خورن! من می‌خوام برشون گردونم.

branches.suggestion: Can you flip them?
What do you need to make them?

n3.speaker: ryan
n3.text: Easy. Flour, eggs, milk. Mum made the batter. I'm going to do the flipping!

translations.fa: آسونه. آرد، تخم‌مرغ، شیر. مامان خمیرش را درست کرده. من برگردوندن را انجام میدم!

branches.suggestion: What's batter?
Are you going to throw it high?

n4.speaker: ryan
n4.text: Really high! Watch this… One, two, three… FLIP!

translations.fa: خیلی بالا! اینو ببین… یک، دو، سه… فلیپ!

branches.suggestion: Wow! You caught it!
Oh no! It's on the floor!

n5.speaker: ryan
n5.text: Ha, I caught it! Now you try. Are you going to be brave?

translations.fa: ها، گرفتمش! حالا تو امتحان کن. می‌خوای شجاع باشی؟

branches.suggestion: I'm going to try.
I'm going to drop it!

recasts.echo: You're going to try? Go on!

n6.speaker: ryan
n6.text: Go on! … Oh! It's on the ceiling! No — it's on Dad's head!

translations.fa: بزن دیگه! … آه! رفت رو سقف! نه — رو سر بابا افتاد!

branches.suggestion: Sorry, Tom!
Ha! Tom is wearing a pancake!

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: Now that's a pancake hat! Nice one. What are you going to put on yours, {you}?

translations.fa: این شد کلاه پنکیکی! خوب بود. رو مال خودت چی می‌خوای بذاری {you}؟

branches.suggestion: Lemon and sugar, please.
I'm going to have chocolate.

cultureNote.en: The classic British pancake topping is lemon juice and sugar.
cultureNote.fa: لیمو و شکر رایج‌ترین رویه.

n8.speaker: ryan
n8.text: Classic! Lemon and sugar. Next year, I'm going to make twenty. And none on Dad's head!

translations.fa: کلاسیک! لیمو و شکر. سال بعد می‌خوام بیست تا درست کنم. و هیچ‌کدوم رو سر بابا نیفته!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: First, you need to register at the surgery. Here's the form. I'll help you.

translations.fa: اول باید تو مطب ثبت‌نام کنی. اینم فرم. کمکت می‌کنم.

branches.suggestion: Thank you. What's a surgery?
OK. What do I write first?

cultureNote.en: In the UK, "surgery" also means a GP's practice — not only an operation!
cultureNote.fa: surgery یعنی مطب هم هست.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: The GP's office. First, your full name. Surname in capital letters.

translations.fa: مطب دکتر عمومی. اول، اسم کاملت. نام خانوادگی با حروف بزرگ.

branches.suggestion: What's a surname?
My surname is long!

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Your family name. Then your address. You're at number ten, Mare Street.

translations.fa: اسم فامیلت. بعد آدرست. تو پلاک ده، خیابون مر هستی.

branches.suggestion: Number ten, Mare Street. What's the postcode?
branches.suggestionFa: پلاک ده، خیابون مر. کد پستی چیه؟

branches.suggestion: Do I write "Flat" or "House"?

cultureNote.en: British "postcode", American "zip code". Every UK address has a postcode, like SW1A 1AA.
cultureNote.fa: postcode/zip code.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: The postcode is the same as ours. I'll write it. Now, date of birth. Day, month, year.

translations.fa: کد پستی مثل مال ماست. من می‌نویسمش. حالا، تاریخ تولد. روز، ماه، سال.

branches.suggestion: Day first, then month?
In Iran we use a different calendar!

cultureNote.en: The UK writes dates day/month/year (05/05/1996); the US writes month/day/year.
cultureNote.fa: ترتیب تاریخ.

recasts.echo: Your date of birth is…? Write the day first.
recasts.better: My date of birth is the fifth of May.

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Use the normal calendar. Day first! Then your phone number and email.

translations.fa: از تقویم معمولی استفاده کن. اول روز! بعد شماره تلفن و ایمیلت.

branches.suggestion: My phone number starts with 07.
Do they need my email?

n6.speaker: receptionist
n6.text: Yes, please. We send reminders by text and email. Do you have an NHS number?

translations.fa: بله، لطفاً. یادآوری‌ها را با پیامک و ایمیل می‌فرستیم. شماره NHS دارید؟

branches.suggestion: No, I don't.
What's an NHS number?

n7.speaker: receptionist
n7.text: That's fine. We'll give you one. You don't need ID or proof of address to register.

translations.fa: اشکالی نداره. یکی بهتون میدیم. برای ثبت‌نام مدرک هویت یا نشانی لازم نیست.

branches.suggestion: Really? That's easy.
When can I see a doctor?

cultureNote.en: Anyone in England can register with a GP for free — you don't need ID, an address proof or immigration status.
cultureNote.fa: ثبت‌نام رایگان در GP.

n8.speaker: receptionist
n8.text: After two or three days. We'll text you. Welcome to the practice!

translations.fa: بعد از دو سه روز. براتون پیامک می‌فرستیم. به مطب خوش اومدید!

n1.speaker: okafor
n1.text: Hello, Leslie. Hello, Nicola. And you're the neighbour? Come in. What's the problem today?

translations.fa: سلام لزلی. سلام نیکولا. و شما همسایه هستید؟ بفرمایید. امروز مشکل چیه؟

branches.suggestion: Nicola has an earache.
Her ear hurts.

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: My ear hurts! This one. It's very sore.

translations.fa: گوشم درد می‌کنه! این یکی. خیلی دردناکه.

branches.suggestion: The left ear.
Since last night.

n3.speaker: okafor
n3.text: Oh dear. Since last night? Has she got a temperature?

translations.fa: ای وای. از دیشب؟ تب داره؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, a little.
Leslie checked it this morning.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Thirty-eight point two. And she isn't eating much.

translations.fa: سی و هشت و دو دهم. و زیاد غذا نمی‌خوره.

branches.suggestion: She didn't eat breakfast.
She only had some juice.

cultureNote.en: UK thermometers use Celsius. A child's temperature of 38 °C or more is a fever.
cultureNote.fa: ۳۸ درجه یعنی تب.

n5.speaker: okafor
n5.text: Let me look. Nicola, I'm going to use my little torch. Are you brave?

translations.fa: بذار ببینم. نیکولا، می‌خوام از چراغ‌قوهٔ کوچیکم استفاده کنم. شجاعی؟

branches.suggestion: You're brave, Nicola!
Hold Mummy's hand.

cultureNote.en: British "torch", American "flashlight".
cultureNote.fa: torch/flashlight.

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: I'm brave. Ouch! Is my ear poorly?

translations.fa: من شجاعم. آخ! گوشم مریضه؟

branches.suggestion: The doctor is checking.
Nearly finished!

recasts.echo: Her ear is poorly? Let's see.

n7.speaker: okafor
n7.text: It's a little bit red. It's an ear infection. It usually gets better on its own in three days.

translations.fa: یه کم قرمزه. عفونت گوشه. معمولاً خودش تو سه روز خوب میشه.

branches.suggestion: No medicine?
What can we do at home?

n8.speaker: okafor
n8.text: Children's paracetamol for the pain, and lots of drinks. Come back if she's not better on Friday.

translations.fa: پاراستامول بچه برای درد، و کلی مایعات. اگه تا جمعه خوب نشد برگردید.

branches.suggestion: Thank you, doctor.
Friday. We'll remember.

n9.speaker: okafor
n9.text: And Nicola, here's a sticker for being so brave! Take care, everyone.

translations.fa: و نیکولا، اینم یه برچسب برای این‌همه شجاعت! مراقب باشید، همه.

n1.speaker: okafor
n1.text: OK, {you}. You've got a chest infection. I'm giving you some antibiotics.

translations.fa: خب {you}. عفونت قفسهٔ سینه داری. بهت آنتی‌بیوتیک میدم.

branches.suggestion: How do I take them?
Is it serious?

n2.speaker: okafor
n2.text: No, not serious. Take one tablet three times a day. Morning, afternoon and night.

translations.fa: نه، جدی نیست. روزی سه بار یه قرص بخور. صبح، بعدازظهر و شب.

branches.suggestion: Three times a day.
Before or after food?

recasts.echo: Three times a day? Correct.

n3.speaker: okafor
n3.text: With food. Not on an empty stomach. And for seven days.

translations.fa: با غذا. نه با معدهٔ خالی. و به مدت هفت روز.

branches.suggestion: Seven days. OK.
What if I feel better after three days?
branches.suggestionFa: اگه بعد از سه روز بهتر شدم چی؟

n4.speaker: okafor
n4.text: Good question. Finish all the tablets, even if you feel better. It's important.

translations.fa: سؤال خوبیه. همهٔ قرص‌ها را تموم کن، حتی اگه بهتر شدی. مهمه.

branches.suggestion: I'll finish them all.
Why is that important?

cultureNote.en: UK doctors always say "finish the course" of antibiotics.
cultureNote.fa: دورهٔ آنتی‌بیوتیک را کامل کنید.

n5.speaker: okafor
n5.text: So the infection doesn't come back. Can you drink alcohol with them? Best not.

translations.fa: تا عفونت برنگرده. با این‌ها می‌شه الکل خورد؟ بهتره نه.

branches.suggestion: I don't drink alcohol.
OK. No alcohol.

n6.speaker: okafor
n6.text: Easy, then! Here's your prescription. Take it to the pharmacy. Do you pay for prescriptions?

translations.fa: پس آسونه! اینم نسخه‌ت. ببرش داروخونه. برای نسخه پول میدی؟

branches.suggestion: How much is a prescription?
I don't know. Do I pay?

cultureNote.en: In England a prescription item costs about £10, but many people get them free. In Scotland and Wales they are always free.
cultureNote.fa: هزینهٔ نسخه در انگلیس.

n7.speaker: okafor
n7.text: If you're working, it's a fixed charge. The pharmacist will explain. Rest and drink lots of water.

translations.fa: اگه کار می‌کنی، یه هزینهٔ ثابته. داروساز توضیح میده. استراحت کن و کلی آب بخور.

branches.suggestion: Thank you, Dr Okafor.
When should I come back?

n8.speaker: okafor
n8.text: Only if you're not better in a week, or if you can't breathe well. Take care, {you}!

translations.fa: فقط اگه تا یه هفته بهتر نشدی، یا نتونستی خوب نفس بکشی. مراقب خودت باش {you}!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Look, there's Mrs Khan in the waiting room. Hello, Amina! Are you OK?

translations.fa: ببین، خانم خان تو اتاق انتظاره. سلام آمینا! خوبی؟

branches.suggestion: Hello, Mrs Khan.
She doesn't look well.

n2.speaker: khan
n2.text: Hello, dears. Not really. It's my back. I hurt it in the garden.

translations.fa: سلام عزیزانم. نه زیاد. کمرمه. تو باغچه آسیب دیده.

branches.suggestion: I'm sorry to hear that.
Oh no! What happened?

n3.speaker: khan
n3.text: I lifted a big bag of soil. Silly me! Now I can't bend down.

translations.fa: یه کیسهٔ بزرگ خاک بلند کردم. چه کار احمقانه‌ای! الان نمی‌تونم خم بشم.

branches.suggestion: That sounds painful.
You need to rest.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Can we do anything? Shopping? Walking Tiger? Ha, cats don't need walking.

translations.fa: کاری از دستمون برمیاد؟ خرید؟ گردوندن تایگر؟ ها، گربه‌ها که گردوندن نمی‌خوان.

branches.suggestion: I can do your shopping.
I can put your bins out.

n5.speaker: khan
n5.text: You're so kind. Yes, the bins, please. Tuesday. And maybe some milk?

translations.fa: خیلی مهربونی. آره، سطل‌ها، لطفاً. سه‌شنبه. و شاید یه کم شیر؟

branches.suggestion: No problem at all.
I'll bring milk tomorrow.

match: i bring milk tomorrow morning yes
recasts.echo: You'll bring milk? Thank you!

n6.speaker: receptionist
n6.text: Mrs Khan? The doctor's ready for you now. Room two.

translations.fa: خانم خان؟ دکتر الان آماده‌ست. اتاق دو.

branches.suggestion: Good luck, Mrs Khan.
I hope you feel better soon.

cultureNote.en: "Get well soon!" and "I hope you feel better" are common British wishes for someone who is ill.
cultureNote.fa: آرزوی بهبودی.

n7.speaker: khan
n7.text: Thank you, dears. Pop round for a cup of tea when I'm better!

translations.fa: ممنون عزیزانم. وقتی بهتر شدم برای یه چای سر بزنید!

branches.suggestion: We will! Get well soon!
Take care of your back.

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Poor Amina. Let's make her a get-well card with Nicola tonight. She'll love that!

translations.fa: آمینای بیچاره. بیا امشب با نیکولا براش یه کارت آرزوی بهبودی درست کنیم. عاشقش میشه!

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Morning! Jump on. So, how do you get to your English class?

translations.fa: صبح بخیر! بپر بالا. خب، چطوری میری کلاس انگلیسیت؟

branches.suggestion: I go by bus.
Usually I walk.

cultureNote.en: Say "by bus", "by train", "by car" — but "on foot" for walking.
cultureNote.fa: by bus / on foot.

recasts.echo: You go by bus? Good choice!

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: Good choice! The best way. Which bus do you take?

translations.fa: انتخاب خوبیه! بهترین راه. سوار کدوم اتوبوس میشی؟

branches.suggestion: I take the 38.
Sometimes the 55.

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: The 38! My bus! How long does it take?

translations.fa: ۳۸! اتوبوس من! چقدر طول می‌کشه؟

branches.suggestion: It takes twenty minutes.
About half an hour.

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: In the rush hour it's forty minutes! How do you pay?

translations.fa: ساعت شلوغی چهل دقیقه‌ست! چطوری پرداخت می‌کنی؟

branches.suggestion: With my bank card. Contactless.
I've got an Oyster card.

cultureNote.en: London buses don't take cash. Use contactless or an Oyster card. One bus fare covers unlimited buses for an hour (the "Hopper").
cultureNote.fa: اتوبوس لندن نقد نمی‌گیرد.

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: Perfect. And with the Hopper fare, you can change buses for free in an hour.

translations.fa: عالی. و با کرایهٔ هاپر، تو یه ساعت می‌تونی مجانی اتوبوس عوض کنی.

branches.suggestion: For free? That's great.
What's the Hopper fare?

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: One fare, many buses, one hour. Do you go upstairs or downstairs?

translations.fa: یه کرایه، چند تا اتوبوس، یه ساعت. طبقه بالا میری یا پایین؟

branches.suggestion: Upstairs, at the front!
Downstairs. It's easier.

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: Upstairs at the front! Like a kid. Best seat in London. Great view.

translations.fa: بالا جلو! مثل بچه‌ها. بهترین صندلی لندن. منظرهٔ عالی.

branches.suggestion: Do you ever drive a different bus?
Can you see me in your mirror?

n8.speaker: tom
n8.text: Always the 38! And yes, I can see you. So no funny faces! Here's your stop. Have a good class!

translations.fa: همیشه ۳۸! و آره، می‌بینمت. پس شکلک درنیار! ایستگاهت رسید. کلاس خوبی داشته باشی!

n1.speaker: maya
n1.text: Hiya! Are you new on this line? You look a bit lost.

translations.fa: سلام! تو این خط تازه‌کاری؟ یه کم گم‌شده به نظر میای.

branches.suggestion: Yes. Is this the train to Highbury?
I'm going to Stratford. Which platform?

n2.speaker: maya
n2.text: This is the Overground. Platform one for Stratford, platform two for Highbury.

translations.fa: این اورگراونده. سکوی یک برای استراتفورد، سکوی دو برای هایبری.

branches.suggestion: Platform one. Thank you.
What's the Overground?

cultureNote.en: The London Overground is the orange train line. Like the Tube, you can tap in with contactless.
cultureNote.fa: اورگراوند خط نارنجی.

n3.speaker: maya
n3.text: It's like the Tube, but outside. The orange line. When's your train?

translations.fa: مثل متروئه، ولی روی زمین. خط نارنجی. قطارت کیه؟

branches.suggestion: When's the next train?
I don't know. Is there a timetable?

recasts.echo: When's the next train? Look at the board!

n4.speaker: maya
n4.text: Look at the board. Next train in four minutes. Did you tap in?

translations.fa: به تابلو نگاه کن. قطار بعدی چهار دقیقهٔ دیگه. کارت زدی؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I tapped in at the gate.
Oh no! I forgot.

n5.speaker: maya
n5.text: Always tap in and tap out. Or you pay the maximum fare!

translations.fa: همیشه موقع ورود و خروج کارت بزن. وگرنه بیشترین کرایه را میدی!

branches.suggestion: Thanks for the tip.
How much is the maximum fare?

n6.speaker: maya
n6.text: Too much! Mind the gap when you get on. It's a big step.

translations.fa: خیلی زیاد! موقع سوار شدن حواست به فاصله باشه. پله‌ش بلنده.

branches.suggestion: "Mind the gap"! I know that one!
How many stops is Stratford?

cultureNote.en: "Mind the gap" — the famous London announcement — warns about the space between the train and the platform.
cultureNote.fa: Mind the gap.

n7.speaker: maya
n7.text: Three stops. About ten minutes. Here it comes! Have a good trip!

translations.fa: سه ایستگاه. حدود ده دقیقه. داره میاد! سفر خوبی داشته باشی!

branches.suggestion: Thanks, Maya!
Is it always this busy?

n8.speaker: maya
n8.text: At eight in the morning, yes! Squeeze on. Bye!

translations.fa: ساعت هشت صبح، آره! خودت را جا کن. خداحافظ!

n1.speaker: doris
n1.text: Hello again, dear! Today I'm on the bus. My grandson usually drives me, but he's at work.

translations.fa: دوباره سلام عزیزم! امروز سوار اتوبوسم. معمولاً نوه‌م منو می‌رسونه، ولی سر کاره.

branches.suggestion: Hello, Doris! How are you?
Do you like the bus or the car?
branches.suggestionFa: اتوبوس را دوست دارید یا ماشین؟

n2.speaker: doris
n2.text: The car is faster. But the bus is cheaper. It's free for me! I've got a Freedom Pass.

translations.fa: ماشین سریع‌تره. ولی اتوبوس ارزون‌تره. برای من مجانیه! کارت فریدم دارم.

branches.suggestion: Free? That's great.
What's a Freedom Pass?

cultureNote.en: Older people in London get a Freedom Pass for free travel on buses and trains.
cultureNote.fa: کارت سفر رایگان سالمندان.

n3.speaker: doris
n3.text: Free travel for old ducks like me! Do you drive, dear?

translations.fa: سفر مجانی برای پیرزن‌هایی مثل من! تو رانندگی می‌کنی عزیزم؟

branches.suggestion: No. I haven't got a car.
I drove in Iran, but not here.
branches.suggestionFa: تو ایران رانندگی می‌کردم، ولی اینجا نه.

n4.speaker: doris
n4.text: Driving in London is terrible. Traffic, parking… Walking is healthier!

translations.fa: رانندگی تو لندن افتضاحه. ترافیک، پارکینگ… پیاده‌روی سالم‌تره!

branches.suggestion: Walking is healthier, and it's free.
But walking is slower.

recasts.echo: Healthier? Yes, much!

n5.speaker: doris
n5.text: Slower, yes. But I see more! I walk to the shops every morning. Ten thousand steps!

translations.fa: کندتر، آره. ولی بیشتر می‌بینم! هر صبح پیاده میرم مغازه. ده هزار قدم!

branches.suggestion: Ten thousand? Wow!
That's more than me!

n6.speaker: doris
n6.text: Well, maybe five thousand. Ha! What's better, a car or a bus, in Tehran?

translations.fa: خب، شاید پنج هزار. ها! تو تهران چی بهتره، ماشین یا اتوبوس؟

branches.suggestion: The metro is faster than a car.
Taxis are cheaper than here.

n7.speaker: doris
n7.text: Cheaper taxis! Lucky you. Here a taxi is more expensive than a holiday! Ah, there's my stop.

translations.fa: تاکسی ارزون‌تر! خوش به حالت. اینجا تاکسی از تعطیلات گرون‌تره! آه، ایستگاهم رسید.

branches.suggestion: Bye, Doris! Take care.
Do you need help with your bag?

n8.speaker: doris
n8.text: No thank you, dear. Walking is good for me, remember! Bye-bye! Bye, Tom!

translations.fa: نه ممنون عزیزم. پیاده‌روی برام خوبه، یادته! خداحافظ! خداحافظ تام!

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Look at all those bikes! More bikes than buses now. Do you ride a bike, {you}?

translations.fa: این همه دوچرخه را ببین! الان دوچرخه از اتوبوس بیشتره. تو دوچرخه سواری می‌کنی {you}؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I can ride a bike.
Not in London. It's scary!

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: It's safer now. There are cycle lanes. You should try a hire bike.

translations.fa: الان امن‌تره. مسیر دوچرخه هست. باید یه دوچرخهٔ کرایه‌ای امتحان کنی.

branches.suggestion: What's a hire bike?
Where can I get one?

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: The red ones over there. You use an app. You pay by the half hour.

translations.fa: اون قرمزها اونجا. با یه اپ. هر نیم ساعت پول میدی.

branches.suggestion: Is it expensive?
I'll download the app.

cultureNote.en: London's hire bikes are often called "Boris bikes" after a former mayor.
cultureNote.fa: دوچرخه‌های کرایه‌ای لندن.

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: Not bad. A few pounds. But you should wear a helmet.

translations.fa: بد نیست. چند پوند. ولی باید کلاه ایمنی بذاری.

branches.suggestion: I should wear a helmet.
Is a helmet the law?

recasts.echo: You should wear a helmet? Exactly!

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: It's not the law, but it's smart. And you shouldn't ride on the pavement.

translations.fa: قانون نیست، ولی عاقلانه‌ست. و نباید رو پیاده‌رو برونی.

branches.suggestion: Where should I ride?
OK. Not on the pavement.

cultureNote.en: British "pavement", American "sidewalk".
cultureNote.fa: pavement/sidewalk.

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: On the road or in the cycle lane. And keep left! We drive on the left here.

translations.fa: تو خیابون یا مسیر دوچرخه. و از چپ برو! اینجا از چپ رانندگی می‌کنیم.

branches.suggestion: Keep left. I'll remember.
In Iran we drive on the right.
branches.suggestionFa: تو ایران از راست رانندگی می‌کنیم.

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: That's the tricky bit! And one more thing — you shouldn't ride in front of my bus! Ha!

translations.fa: قسمت سختش همینه! و یه چیز دیگه — نباید جلوی اتوبوس من برونی! ها!

branches.suggestion: I promise!
Do you ride a bike, Tom?

n8.speaker: tom
n8.text: Me? On a bike? I sit down all day. My legs only know the pedals of a bus! Ha!

translations.fa: من؟ دوچرخه؟ کل روز نشستم. پاهام فقط پدال اتوبوس را می‌شناسه! ها!

l1_u43_1.title: Excuse me, can you help me?

n1.speaker: priya
n1.text: Hi there! You look a bit lost. Can I help you with anything?

translations.fa: سلام! یه کم سردرگم به نظر میاید. کمکی از دستم برمیاد؟

branches.suggestion: Excuse me, can you help me?
Yes, please. I'm looking for saffron.

n2.speaker: priya
n2.text: Of course! What are you looking for?

translations.fa: البته! دنبال چی می‌گردید؟

branches.suggestion: Do you sell saffron?
Where are the spices?

recasts.echo: Do we sell saffron? We do!

n3.speaker: priya
n3.text: We do! Spices are in aisle six. But saffron is behind the till. It's very expensive!

translations.fa: می‌فروشیم! ادویه‌ها راهروی شیشن. ولی زعفرون پشت صندوقه. خیلی گرونه!

branches.suggestion: Why is it behind the till?
Is it locked up?

cultureNote.en: Small expensive items like saffron, razor blades or perfume are often kept behind the till in UK shops.
cultureNote.fa: اقلام گران پشت صندوق.

n4.speaker: priya
n4.text: People steal it! It's like gold. What are you cooking?

translations.fa: مردم می‌دزدنش! مثل طلاست. چی می‌پزید؟

branches.suggestion: Persian rice with saffron.
A chicken dish for my neighbours.

n5.speaker: priya
n5.text: Lovely! Do you need anything else? Basmati rice? We've got big bags.

translations.fa: عالی! چیز دیگه‌ای لازم دارید؟ برنج باسماتی؟ کیسهٔ بزرگ داریم.

branches.suggestion: Yes, please. Where is the rice?
Can you show me the yogurt too?

n6.speaker: priya
n6.text: Rice is in aisle four, on the bottom shelf. Yogurt is in the fridges at the back.

translations.fa: برنج تو راهروی چهار، قفسهٔ پایین. ماست تو یخچال‌های ته فروشگاهه.

branches.suggestion: Thank you for your help.
At the back. OK.

n7.speaker: priya
n7.text: You're welcome! When you're ready, come to my till. I'll get the saffron for you.

translations.fa: خواهش می‌کنم! هر وقت آماده بودید بیاید صندوق من. زعفرون را براتون میارم.

branches.suggestion: Brilliant. See you in a minute.
How much is the saffron?

n8.speaker: priya
n8.text: About four pounds for a tiny box. Precious stuff! Enjoy your cooking!

translations.fa: حدود چهار پوند برای یه جعبهٔ کوچولو. چیز گرون‌بهاییه! آشپزی خوش بگذره!

n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: Mum sent me with a list. Ten things! I can't find anything. Help!

translations.fa: مامان با یه لیست فرستادم. ده تا چیز! هیچی پیدا نمی‌کنم. کمک!

branches.suggestion: Let me see the list.
What can't you find?

n2.speaker: ryan
n2.text: Milk, first. I can't find the milk! I've walked round twice!

translations.fa: اول شیر. شیر را پیدا نمی‌کنم! دو بار دور زدم!

branches.suggestion: It's in the fridges at the back.
Look at the signs.

n3.speaker: ryan
n3.text: Got it. Semi-skimmed. Green top. Mum says never the blue one.

translations.fa: گرفتم. نیم‌چرب. درِ سبز. مامان میگه هیچ‌وقت آبیه نه.

branches.suggestion: What's the blue one?
Next thing on the list?

cultureNote.en: UK milk bottle colours: blue = whole milk, green = semi-skimmed, red = skimmed.
cultureNote.fa: رنگ درِ شیر.
